title: Visual Graph Scaffolds for Structural Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Graphs have been used to enhance large language models (LLMs) for structured reasoning, mostly as external knowledge sources are provided to models at test time. In this paper, we take a different view: the value of graphs for LLMs lie not only in supplying information, but also in organizing reasoning. Inspired by how humans use graph-structured mind maps to organize branching and converging thoughts, we ask whether graphs can serve as an internal form of reasoning assistance. We study this question on multi-hop question answering tasks, where teacher-provided reasoning traces are rewritten as graph mind maps and used to guide a student model. Our experiments reveal a clear modality gap. When graph structures are flattened into text, their benefits become limited once direct answer hints are removed. Under this abstract guidance setting, both reasoning efficiency and answer quality degrade substantially. In contrast, visual graph guidance remains effective without direct answer clues, and its advantage persists after supervised fine-tuning and KL-based distillation. The above findings support the claim that graphs should be studied not only as external knowledge structures for LLMs, but also as visual scaffolds for organizing reasoning.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了图结构作为大语言模型内部推理组织工具的价值，而非仅作为外部知识源。通过多跳问答实验发现，视觉图引导比文本化图引导更具优势，尤其在去除直接答案线索后，图结构能有效组织分支与汇聚推理。
AI.motivation: 现有研究将图作为LLM的外部知识源，但本文探索图是否可以作为内部的推理组织形式（类似人类思维导图），帮助模型组织分支与汇聚推理。
AI.method: 将教师提供的推理轨迹重写为思维导图，在多跳问答任务中分别以文本化图和视觉图形式引导学生模型，对比两种引导方式的效果。
AI.result: 图结构扁平化为文本后，去掉直接答案提示则效果大幅下降；而视觉图引导在无直接答案线索时仍有效，且在监督微调和KL蒸馏后优势持续存在。
AI.conclusion: 图不仅应作为LLM的外部知识结构，更应作为组织推理的可视化支架，视觉图的模态特性对推理组织具有独特价值。
idea_en: Method of using graph-structured mind maps as internal reasoning scaffolds for LLMs, where reasoning traces are converted into graph representations to guide multi-hop question answering without providing direct answer hints.

Visual graph guidance framework that maintains reasoning effectiveness even after flattening graph structures into text degrades performance, leveraging the modality gap between visual and textual graph representations.

Teacher-student distillation approach where graph mind maps from teacher reasoning traces are used to guide student models, with visual graph guidance showing persistent advantages after supervised fine-tuning and KL-based distillation.

System for organizing branching and converging thoughts in LLMs using graph-structured visual scaffolds, applicable to multi-hop reasoning tasks where graphs serve as internal reasoning organization tools rather than external knowledge sources.
idea_ch: 将推理轨迹重写为图结构思维导图，并作为大型语言模型的内部推理支架的方法，在多跳问答中无需提供直接答案线索即可引导模型推理。
视觉图引导框架，利用图结构在视觉模态与文本模态之间的模态差异，在文本化图结构效果退化时仍保持推理有效性。
基于教师-学生蒸馏的方法，将教师推理轨迹的图思维导图用于引导学生模型，视觉图引导在监督微调和KL蒸馏后仍保持持续优势。
利用图结构可视化支架组织大语言模型中分支与汇聚推理的系统，图作为内部推理组织工具而非外部知识源，适用于多跳推理任务。

title: AURA: Action-Gated Memory for Robot Policies at Constant VRAM
summary:
The KV-cache is the right memory for datacenters but the wrong memory for robots. Datacenter inference batches many short requests and resets them, amortizing an attention cache across a crowd. Embodied agents instead run one long, non-resetting episode on bandwidth-limited edge hardware, where high-bandwidth memory and flash are scarce, flash has finite write endurance, and memory writes rather than compute can become the binding constraint.
  AURA-Mem (Action-Utility Recurrent Adaptive Memory) targets this regime. It wraps a frozen vision-language-action backbone with a constant-size recurrent memory and a learned gate that writes only when the current observation would change the next action: memory that knows when to stay silent. Unlike reconstruction-based memory, the gate is trained directly against a closed-loop action-error signal. Its inference state is fixed at 4,224 bytes regardless of horizon, while a KV-cache grows to 6,061 times larger at 100,000 steps.
  On a controlled synthetic benchmark, AURA-Mem matches the best O(1) baseline in accuracy while using 5.19-6.13 times fewer writes, and up to 9.19 times fewer writes on easier configurations. Budget-matched random and periodic schedules do not recover this gain, isolating the benefit to the action-surprise signal. On a trained closed-loop OpenVLA-OFT 7B panel on LIBERO-Long (n=60 episodes per arm), the gate does not hurt success: AURA-Mem matches the ungated base policy (0.233) and slightly exceeds an always-write KV arm (0.217), while using 7.0 times fewer writes and constant memory. We also instantiate an approximate-information-state value-loss bound as a methodology demonstration; at this scale, the bound is vacuous rather than a guarantee.

AI.tldr: AURA-Mem提出了一种用于机器人边缘设备的恒定大小循环记忆系统，通过学习门控机制仅在观测影响动作时写入记忆，在保持任务成功率的同时大幅减少写入次数和内存占用。
AI.motivation: 数据中心推理场景下的KV-cache方法不适用于机器人边缘设备，因为机器人需要长时间连续运行、无法重置，且边缘设备带宽有限、闪存写入寿命有限，内存写入成为瓶颈。
AI.method: 基于冻结的视觉-语言-动作骨干网络，添加恒定大小的循环记忆和可学习门控机制。门控通过闭环动作误差信号直接训练，仅当当前观测会改变下一步动作时才写入记忆，而非传统基于重建的方法。
AI.result: 在合成基准测试中，AURA-Mem达到最佳O(1)基线准确率，同时减少5.19-6.13倍写入次数；在LIBERO-Long真实机器人任务中，匹配无门控基线的成功率(0.233)，优于始终写入的KV基线(0.217)，同时减少7.0倍写入次数，内存开销恒定4,224字节。
AI.conclusion: AURA-Mem证明了基于动作误差信号的学习门控机制可以有效减少机器人边缘设备上的内存写入次数而不影响任务成功率，解决了数据中心方法不适合机器人场景的问题。
idea_en: A learnable gating mechanism for robot memory that writes to recurrent memory only when current observation would change the next action, trained directly against a closed-loop action-error signal rather than reconstruction loss.

A constant-size recurrent memory system (4,224 bytes) for embodied agents that wraps a frozen vision-language-action backbone, achieving 6,061x smaller memory footprint than KV-cache at 100,000 steps.

Action-surprise-based memory write scheduling that dynamically decides when to store observations based on their impact on action prediction, outperforming budget-matched random and periodic schedules.
A methodology for instantiation of approximate-information-state value-loss bound for evaluating memory system performance in closed-loop robotic control.
idea_ch: 一种基于可学习门控机制的机器人记忆系统，仅在当前观测会改变下一步动作时写入循环记忆，门控直接通过闭环动作误差信号训练而非传统的重建损失函数
一种恒定大小的循环记忆系统（仅4,224字节），包裹冻结的视觉-语言-动作骨干网络，在100,000步时相比KV-cache减少6,061倍内存占用
基于动作惊喜度（action-surprise）的记忆写入调度方法，根据观测对动作预测的影响动态决定是否存储，优于基于随机或周期性的预算匹配写入策略
一种用于评估闭环机器人控制中记忆系统性能的近似信息状态值损失界（approximate-information-state value-loss bound）的实例化方法论

title: Evaluating Transformer and LSTM Frameworks for Prediction in Ungauged Basins
summary: Watershed networks exhibit convergent topologies in which multiple tributaries merge into downstream channels,integrating diverse upstream hydrological processes. In ungauged basins, the absence of direct observations increases uncertainty and limits the ability to anticipate extreme events. This study evaluates whether an encoder-only Transformer provides an advantage over an LSTM for upstream streamflow inference under limited hydrologic information, using retrospective simulations from the NOAA National Water Model (NWM). Across both upstream-only and combined configurations, the LSTM showed stronger overall performance than the Transformer model across the two configurations. Incorporating downstream information further boosted performance for all models, increasing median NNSE by more than 60%. Rather than treating this as a leaderboard-style comparison, we interpret the experiments as a test of architectural inductive bias for hydrologic sequence inference. The results indicate that recurrent memory remains better aligned with this upstream reconstruction task than an encoder-only Transformer, while downstream hydrologic context provides a strong auxiliary constraint that substantially improves prediction skill across architectures

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了编码器-only Transformer与LSTM在无观测流域上游径流推断中的表现，发现LSTM整体优于Transformer，而加入下游信息可使中位数NNSE提升超过60%。
AI.motivation: 在无观测流域中，缺乏直接观测数据增加了不确定性，限制了极端事件的预测能力。需要探索不同神经网络架构（如Transformer和LSTM）对水文序列推断的归纳偏置，以提升上游径流预测性能。
AI.method: 使用NOAA国家水模型（NWM）的回顾性模拟数据，比较编码器-only Transformer与LSTM在上游径流推断任务中的表现，分别测试仅上游信息和结合下游信息的两种配置。
AI.result: LSTM在两种配置下整体表现均优于Transformer；加入下游信息后所有模型性能显著提升，中位数NNSE提高超过60%。
AI.conclusion: 循环记忆（LSTM）比编码器-only Transformer更适合上游径流重建任务，而下游水文上下文信息作为强辅助约束能显著提升预测技能。
idea_en: A method for upstream streamflow inference in ungauged basins using a recurrent neural network (e.g., LSTM) enhanced by downstream hydrologic context information, improving prediction accuracy by over 60%.
An encoder-only Transformer architecture configured specifically for hydrologic sequence inference in watershed networks, enabling upstream streamflow estimation without recurrent components.
A dual-configuration hydrologic inference system that selectively uses upstream-only or combined upstream-downstream information to optimize streamflow prediction under data-scarce conditions.
A technique leveraging retrospective simulations from large-scale national water models (e.g., NOAA NWM) as training data for neural network-based streamflow inference in ungauged basins.
idea_ch: 一种利用下游水文上下文信息增强的循环神经网络（如LSTM）用于无观测流域上游径流推断的方法，可将预测精度提升超过60%。
一种专为流域网络水文序列推断设计的编码器-only Transformer架构，无需循环组件即可实现上游径流估计。
一种双配置水文推断系统，可选择使用仅上游信息或上下游结合信息，在数据稀缺条件下优化径流预测。
一种利用大规模国家水模型（如NOAA NWM）回顾性模拟数据作为训练数据，实现无观测流域基于神经网络的径流推断技术。

title: BehaviorBench: Modeling Real-World User Decisions from Behavioral Traces
summary: Many decision-support settings require systems that adapt to individual users, but evaluation data for this problem remain limited. Existing benchmarks for user understanding often rely on simulated users or model-generated behavior, even though recent work cautions that model-based simulations can diverge systematically from human behavior. We introduce \textsc{BehaviorBench}, a benchmark for evaluating personalized decision modeling from real-world behavioral traces. \textsc{BehaviorBench} reconstructs wallet-level decision histories from observed public prediction-market and on-chain records, and organizes them into two complementary task layers: \emph{Belief prediction}, which predicts a user's final revealed stance and confidence in a market, and \emph{Trade prediction}, which predicts the direction and amount of individual transactions. Across 2,000 evaluation wallets, the benchmark contains 141,445 Belief instances and 1,485,972 Trade instances, with disjoint support pools for retrieval-based evaluation. We evaluate frontier and open-weight generative models under four history interfaces: no personalization, direct recent history, generated user profiles, and retrieved support-wallet evidence. Personalization improves Belief prediction more consistently than Trade prediction, model rankings change across task layers and metrics, and different history interfaces expose different failure modes. \textsc{BehaviorBench} provides an evaluation setting for studying whether personalized methods can use real-world behavioral evidence rather than simulated users alone.

AI.tldr: BehaviorBench是一个用于评估个性化决策建模的基准，包含来自预测市场和链上记录的141,445个信念预测实例和1,485,972个交易预测实例，覆盖2,000个钱包。研究发现个性化在信念预测上比交易预测更有效，不同历史接口暴露不同失败模式。
AI.motivation: 现有用户理解基准多依赖模拟用户或模型生成行为，但模型模拟可能系统地偏离真实人类行为，缺乏基于真实世界行为轨迹的个性化决策建模评估基准。
AI.method: 从公开的预测市场和链上记录重建钱包级决策历史，构建信念预测（预测用户最终立场和信心）和交易预测（预测交易方向和金额）两个互补任务层，使用四种历史接口（无个性化、直接近期历史、生成用户画像、检索支持钱包证据）评估生成模型。
AI.result: 个性化在信念预测上比交易预测更一致地提升性能；模型排名在不同任务层和指标上发生变化；不同历史接口暴露不同的失败模式。
AI.conclusion: BehaviorBench提供了一个基于真实世界行为证据而非模拟用户的个性化方法评估环境，揭示了个性化在不同任务上的差异化效果和模型评估的复杂性。
idea_en: A system that reconstructs wallet-level decision histories from public prediction-market and on-chain records for personalized decision modeling
A dual-task benchmark framework combining belief prediction (stance and confidence) and trade prediction (direction and amount) for evaluating user personalization
A retrieval-based evaluation method using disjoint support pools to match target users with similar historical behavior evidence
A multi-interface history evaluation approach (no personalization, direct history, generated profiles, retrieved evidence) to assess personalization failure modes
idea_ch: 基于公开预测市场和链上记录重建钱包级决策历史用于个性化决策建模的系统
结合信念预测（立场与信心）和交易预测（方向与金额）的双任务基准框架用于评估用户个性化
使用不重叠支持池的检索式评估方法，将目标用户与相似历史行为证据匹配
多接口历史评估方法（无个性化、直接历史、生成画像、检索证据）用于分析个性化失败模式

title: ChatHealthAI: Aligning Electronic Health Record Representations with Large Language Models for Grounded Clinical Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong natural-language reasoning abilities for clinical decision support, but struggle to effectively model structured longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs). In contrast, EHR foundation models can learn predictive patient representations, yet lack interpretable language-based reasoning. To bridge this gap, we propose ChatHealthAI, a multimodal reasoning framework that aligns structured EHR representations from a pretrained EHR foundation model with the semantic space of a frozen LLM through a task-aware resampler. By integrating longitudinal patient representations with refined clinical event descriptions, ChatHealthAI enables clinically grounded natural-language reasoning while maintaining accurate patient prediction. We evaluated ChatHealthAI on three clinical predictive tasks from the EHRSHOT benchmark. Results show that ChatHealthAI improves reasoning quality and interpretability while preserving competitive predictive performance. These findings highlight the potential of integrating EHR foundation models with pretrained LLMs for interpretable clinical prediction.

AI.tldr: ChatHealthAI是一个多模态推理框架，通过任务感知重采样器将预训练的EHR基础模型与冻结的LLM对齐，实现结构化的纵向EHR表示与自然语言推理的结合，在三个临床预测任务上展示了良好的推理质量和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在临床决策支持中具备强大的自然语言推理能力，但难以有效处理结构化的纵向电子健康记录；而EHR基础模型虽然能学习预测性患者表示，但缺乏可解释的基于语言的推理。两者之间存在能力鸿沟，需要一种能够融合结构化EHR表示与自然语言推理优势的方法。
AI.method: 提出ChatHealthAI框架，通过任务感知重采样器（task-aware resampler）将预训练EHR基础模型的结构化纵向患者表示与冻结的LLM的语义空间进行对齐，同时整合精细化的临床事件描述，实现临床可解释的自然语言推理。
AI.result: 在EHRSHOT基准的三个临床预测任务上，ChatHealthAI在保持竞争性预测性能的同时，显著提升了推理质量和可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 将EHR基础模型与预训练LLM融合是实现可解释临床预测的有效途径，为结合结构化和非结构化临床数据提供了新范式。
idea_en: Task-aware resampler for aligning structured EHR representations with LLM semantic space
Multimodal reasoning framework integrating longitudinal patient representations with refined clinical event descriptions
Frozen LLM-based clinical reasoning system augmented by pretrained EHR foundation model
Interpretable clinical prediction method combining structured EHR and natural language reasoning
idea_ch: 基于任务感知重采样器的EHR结构化表示与LLM语义空间对齐方法
融合纵向患者表示与精细化临床事件描述的多模态临床推理框架
利用预训练EHR基础模型增强冻结LLM的临床推理能力的技术方案
结合结构化EHR数据与自然语言推理的可解释临床预测系统

title: Traj-Evolve: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent System for Patient Trajectory Modeling in Lung Cancer Early Detection
summary: Modeling patient trajectories from longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs) requires reasoning over sparse, noisy, and long-context multimodal sequences. Existing LLM-based multi-agent systems address context length but process patients in isolation, failing to mirror how clinicians leverage accumulated experience from similar prior cases. We present Traj-Evolve, a self-evolving multi-agent system with two complementary evolving mechanisms. First, an Experience Pool (ExPool) acts as a non-parametric memory, indexing rejection-sampled reasoning traces to retrieve similar patients as few-shot contexts. Second, multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) via reward-ranked fine-tuning parametrically optimizes inter-agent and agent-memory collaboration. A leave-one-out cross-retrieval strategy unifies the two, aligning training- and inference-time behavior under retrieval augmentation. On a lung cancer prediction task utilizing up to five years of multimodal EHRs, Traj-Evolve outperforms 9 strong baselines on the overall population and a challenging never-smoker population. Analysis of the evolving dynamics highlights three key findings: (1) expanding the ExPool shifts optimal retrieval from diverse to specific samples; (2) under MARL, the manager agent's prediction loss converges quickly while the worker agents' temporal reasoning continues to benefit from more verified patients; and (3) the two mechanisms are complementary on the predicted risk, where ExPool improves specificity while MARL improves sensitivity.

AI.tldr: Traj-Evolve是一个自我进化的多智能体系统，通过经验池（ExPool）存储拒绝采样的推理轨迹作为非参数记忆，并结合多智能体强化学习（MARL）进行参数优化，采用留一法交叉检索策略统一训练和推理行为，在电子病历轨迹建模中显著优于9个基线模型。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的多智能体系统虽然解决了长上下文问题，但每个患者被孤立处理，无法像临床医生那样从相似历史病例中积累经验，缺乏利用先前类似病例知识的能力。
AI.method: 提出Traj-Evolve系统，包含两种互补的进化机制：(1) 经验池(ExPool)：非参数记忆，存储拒绝采样的推理轨迹，检索相似患者作为少样本上下文；(2) 多智能体强化学习(MARL)：通过奖励排名的微调参数化优化智能体间及智能体与记忆的协作。采用留一法交叉检索策略统一两者。
AI.result: 在长达五年的多模态电子病历肺癌预测任务上，Traj-Evolve在整体人群和具有挑战性的从不吸烟人群上均优于9个强基线模型。分析表明：ExPool扩展使最优检索从多样化转向特化样本；MARL下管理者收敛快而工作者持续受益；ExPool提升特异性，MARL提升敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 经验池与多智能体强化学习两种机制在预测风险上互补，ExPool提升特异性而MARL提升敏感性，验证了利用历史病例经验增强患者轨迹建模的有效性。
idea_en: A self-evolving multi-agent system for longitudinal EHR trajectory modeling, comprising an Experience Pool (ExPool) as non-parametric memory storing rejection-sampled reasoning traces from similar prior patients for few-shot context retrieval.

A multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) framework with reward-ranked fine-tuning that parametrically optimizes inter-agent collaboration and agent-memory interaction in medical trajectory reasoning.
A leave-one-out cross-retrieval strategy that unifies training-time and inference-time behavior under retrieval augmentation for patient trajectory modeling.
A dual complementary mechanism combining non-parametric memory (ExPool) for specificity improvement and parametric MARL optimization for sensitivity improvement in disease risk prediction.
An evolving mechanism where the Experience Pool dynamically shifts optimal retrieval from diverse samples to specific samples as the pool expands, enabling adaptive few-shot context selection.
idea_ch: 一种用于纵向电子病历轨迹建模的自我进化多智能体系统，包含作为非参数记忆的经验池(ExPool)，存储来自相似历史病例的拒绝采样推理轨迹，为少样本上下文检索提供支持。
一种基于多智能体强化学习(MARL)的奖励排名微调框架，参数化地优化医疗轨迹推理中智能体间协作及智能体与记忆的交互。
一种留一法交叉检索策略，在检索增强框架下统一患者轨迹建模的训练阶段和推理阶段行为。
一种结合非参数记忆(ExPool)提升特异性和参数化MARL优化提升敏感性的双互补机制，用于疾病风险预测。
一种经验池动态进化机制：随着经验池扩展，最优检索策略从多样化样本自动转向特化样本，实现适应性少样本上下文选择。

title: An Exploration of Collision-based Enemy Morphology Generation
summary: Despite a great deal of prior research into Procedural Content Generation (PCG), relatively little prior work has explored generating enemies for video games. In particular, there is almost no work on generating enemy morphologies, the basic body plan or collision information for in-game enemies, despite the existence of related morphology generation work in robotics. In this paper, we explore three different novel approaches to generate enemy morphologies based on player collision information. We found that each approach provides different strengths and weaknesses, but all had equivalent or better performance than an evolutionary baseline adapted from prior robotics morphology work.

AI.tldr: 本文探索了三种基于玩家碰撞信息生成敌人形态的新方法，这些方法在性能上均优于或等同于从机器人形态学改编的进化基线方法。
AI.motivation: 程序化内容生成(PCG)领域对游戏敌人的生成研究不足，特别是敌人形态（基本身体结构/碰撞信息）的生成几乎没有相关工作，尽管机器人学中存在相关的形态生成研究。

title: Thinking Past the Answer: Evaluating Harmful Overthinking in Large Reasoning Models
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) improve performance by generating explicit intermediate reasoning traces through increased test-time compute, yet the assumption that longer reasoning is consistently beneficial remains under-examined. While recent evidence shows that additional reasoning can lead models to overthink, we ask: "Once a model has reached the correct answer, does further reasoning refine the solution, or deviate from it?" To study the dynamics after correctness, we introduce a prefix-level trajectory evaluation protocol grounded in reasoning sufficiency, defining the minimum reasoning budget required for a model to first generate the correct answer. This allows us to disentangle verbose overthinking, where additional reasoning is redundant but harmless, from harmful overthinking, where continued reasoning destabilizes an already-correct trajectory. Starting from multimodal benchmarks, we find that many instances considered reasoning-intensive require surprisingly little reasoning. Moreover, stopping at the first correct prefix improves accuracy over standard reasoning up to 21%, revealing that current models are limited not only by their ability to reason, but also by their inability to stop at the right time. Furthermore, while common efficiency strategies like early stopping substantially reduce verbose overthinking (up to 50%), they fail to mitigate harmful overthinking. Failure analysis reveals that correctness deviations are mainly driven by logical drift and visual reinterpretation. Finally, we show that our findings generalize to language-only reasoning benchmarks, highlighting harmful overthinking as a broader reliability risk. Code available at https://simonecaldarella.github.io/thinking-past-the-answer.

title: Toward a Modular Architecture for Embedded AI Agent Systems at the Edge
summary:
The rise of Large Language Models (LLMs) has enabled agentic AI capable of complex reasoning and tool use; however, deploying such autonomy in pervasive computing environments remains challenging due to the strict memory and energy constraints of embedded microcontrollers. Existing frameworks typically assume server-class resources or continuous connectivity, leaving a gap for deeply embedded systems. This paper proposes a modular reference architecture for Embedded Agent Systems that bridges the divide between deterministic real-time control and agentic intelligence.
  We introduce a tiered design that decouples On-Device Agents - executing highly compressed neural networks and rule-based logic for low-latency, privacy-critical tasks - from Cloud-Augmented Agents that leverage Small Language Models (SLMs) for higher-level reasoning and planning. A key contribution is the integration of a cross-cutting Governance Layer, ensuring observability, policy enforcement, and safety across distributed fleets of autonomous devices. Rather than presenting purely empirical benchmarks, we analyze architectural design principles and trade-offs regarding latency, energy, and reliable execution in resource-constrained environments.

AI.result: 分析了架构设计原则及延迟、能耗、可靠执行等资源约束环境下的权衡，而非给出纯经验性基准测试结果。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的层分离设计和治理机制能够有效桥接确定性实时控制与代理智能之间的差距，为在嵌入式环境中部署自主AI系统提供了可行的架构路径。

title: Don't Gamble, GAMBLe: An Analytical Framework for AI-Driven Research Systems
comment: Preprint. 21 pages (10 main, 11 appendix). 6 figures (2 in main, 4 in appendix)
summary: AI-Driven Research Systems (ADRS) -- systems coupling LLMs with automated evaluation to discover algorithms, proofs, and designs -- are being optimized and adopted across domains, but the tools to analyze them have not kept pace. ADRS performance depends on component interactions that are poorly understood, expensive to explore, and (as we show) not well captured by standard convergence guarantees. These guarantees rely on structural assumptions that do not hold under the ADRS process we formalize. We introduce GAMBLe, a framework that decomposes ADRS behavior into four parameters (generator $G$, assessor $\mathcal{A}$, discovery mechanism $\mathcal{M}$, budget $B$) and one compositional object, the effective landscape $L_{\text{eff}} = \mathcal{A} \circ G$, which reveals that distinct generator-assessor pairs induce structurally different per-problem optimization landscapes. We exercise the framework on 760+ replicated runs (>46,000 iterations) spanning generators from single LLMs to dynamically-adaptive ensembles, mechanisms from greedy selection to co-evolutionary meta-search, and three NP-hard problems whose assessors range from continuous scoring to cliff functions. The experiments reveal no total ordering of generators or mechanisms: frontier models can underperform open-source alternatives and the simplest mechanism sometimes outperforms state-of-the-art meta-search. Results show that even under limited budgets (60 iterations per run), the right component choices can improve performance by 13-67% and search efficiency by 6-39x.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GAMBLe框架，将AI驱动研究系统（ADRS）分解为四个参数和一个有效景观对象，通过760+次复现实验（>46,000次迭代）发现组件选择对性能有13-67%的提升和6-39倍的搜索效率改进，且不存在生成器或机制的绝对排序。
AI.motivation: ADRS系统正在被优化和采用，但缺乏有效的分析工具。现有收敛保证依赖于不成立的结构假设，组件交互难以理解和探索，导致系统性能提升受限。
AI.method: 提出GAMBLe框架，将ADRS行为分解为四个参数（生成器G、评估器A、发现机制M、预算B）和一个组合对象有效景观L_eff = A ∘ G。通过760+次复现实验（>46,000次迭代）验证框架有效性。
AI.result: 不存在生成器或机制的绝对排序；前沿模型可能不如开源替代品；简单机制有时优于最先进的元搜索；在有限预算（每次60次迭代）下，正确组件选择可提升性能13-67%，搜索效率提升6-39倍。
AI.conclusion: ADRS性能高度依赖组件选择，GAMBLe框架为理解和优化ADRS提供了有效的分析工具。

title: When Helping Hurts and How to Fix It: Multi-Agent Debate for Data Cleaning
comment: 27 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables. Includes appendix with full experimental results, prompt templates, and dataset statistics
summary: When does multi-agent debate help data cleaning, and when does it hurt? Across three benchmarks, four model families, and over 6,000 task-condition pairs, we find debate's effect reverses sign: it degrades generation across all four models (-1.6 to -15.5pp) through critique-induced confusion (CIC), hallucinated Critic feedback that the Generator accepts uncritically, yet improves error detection (+27.4pp F1, d=1.0). We derive a debate benefit condition: debate helps when the probability of rescuing a wrong output (Critic verification odds weighted by fixability) exceeds the probability of destroying a correct one. A factorial experiment proves adversarial separation is essential: self-verification with identical tools fails, while a separate Critic with code-execution grounding and evidence-gated generation produces the first debate configuration to significantly exceed single-agent on a generative task (+5.3pp, p<0.05). The condition correctly predicts all nine task types and generalizes with zero false positives across 19 published comparisons in seven domains.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多智能体辩论在数据清洗中的双面效应：生成任务中因"批评引发的混淆"（CIC）导致性能下降，但在错误检测任务中显著提升。通过大规模实验推导出辩论效益条件，并证明对抗性分离（不同工具、代码执行）是辩论有效的关键。
AI.motivation: 探究多智能体辩论在数据清洗任务中何时有益、何时有害，揭示其根本机制并建立可预测的条件。
AI.method: 在3个基准、4个模型家族、6000+任务条件对上系统测试辩论效果。提出辩论效益条件公式，并通过析因实验验证对抗性分离的重要性。
AI.result: 辩论在生成任务中因CIC导致性能下降1.6-15.5pp，但在错误检测中F1提升27.4pp（d=1.0）。对抗性分离（独立Critic+代码执行+证据门控生成）首次在生成任务上显著超越单智能体（+5.3pp）。
AI.conclusion: 辩论效益条件可预测所有9种任务类型，在7个领域的19个已发表比较中零假阳性泛化。
idea_en: A method for multi-agent debate configuration that uses adversarial separation, where the Critic agent has different tools and code-execution grounding from the Generator agent, to prevent critique-induced confusion.
A debate benefit condition formula that predicts when multi-agent debate will improve vs degrade performance, based on the probability of rescuing wrong outputs vs destroying correct ones.
An evidence-gated generation mechanism where the Generator only accepts Critic feedback that is supported by verifiable evidence such as code execution results.
A self-verification failure detection system that uses a separate Critic agent with differential tool access to identify hallucinated feedback in multi-agent debates.
A factorial experiment framework for systematically evaluating the effectiveness of different multi-agent debate configurations across task types and model families.

title: Handoff Debt: The Rediscovery Cost When Coding Agents Take Over Interrupted Tasks
summary: Coding-agent benchmarks evaluate whether a single uninterrupted agent can resolve a repository issue. Real software work is messier: tasks are interrupted, reassigned, reviewed, and resumed from partial states left by another agent or engineer. We study this missing dimension through \emph{handoff debt}: the rediscovery cost imposed when a predecessor's work is opaque or incomplete. Our takeover protocol interrupts a coding agent at deterministic handoff points, freezes the repository, and evaluates successor agents under four handoff views: repository state only, raw trace, summary notes, and structured notes. Across 75 source tasks, the protocol generates 181 handoff-point tasks and 724 takeover runs per successor model. Across three successor models, context-bearing handoffs reduce median agent events by 20--59\% and cumulative prompt tokens by 42--63\% relative to repository-only takeover. Solved-rate effects are smaller and model-dependent, but efficiency gains are consistent. These findings suggest that coding-agent evaluation should report not only whether a task is solved, but also how costly that work is for another agent to resume.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"交接负债"概念，研究编码智能体在被打断、交接、恢复任务时的效率损失，通过中断协议和四种交接视图（仓库状态、原始轨迹、摘要笔记、结构化笔记）评估后继智能体的恢复成本。实验发现上下文承接的交接可大幅减少事件数和提示词消耗，但解决率提升有限且依赖模型。
AI.motivation: 现有编码智能体基准仅评估单次不间断完成任务的能力，但实际软件开发中任务常被打断、重新分配、审查和从他人遗留的中间状态恢复。这种"交接负债"（handoff debt）——前序工作不透明或不完整导致的重新发现成本——尚未被系统研究。
AI.method: 设计了一个接管协议（takeover protocol）：在确定性交接点中断编码智能体，冻结仓库状态，然后让后继智能体在四种交接视图下恢复任务：（1）仅仓库状态；（2）原始轨迹；（3）摘要笔记；（4）结构化笔记。实验在75个源任务上生成181个交接点任务和每个后继模型724次接管运行。
AI.result: 相比仅仓库状态接管，带上下文的交接使后继模型的中位事件数减少20-59%，累积提示词消耗减少42-63%。解决率影响较小且因模型而异，但效率提升是一致的。
AI.conclusion: 编码智能体评估不仅应报告任务是否解决，还应报告另一智能体恢复该工作的成本（交接负债）。
idea_en: A takeover protocol for coding agents that interrupts agents at deterministic handoff points and freezes repository state for successor evaluation
A handoff debt metric quantifying rediscovery cost when a predecessor's work is opaque or incomplete during coding agent handoffs
Four-level handoff view taxonomy (repository-only, raw trace, summary notes, structured notes) for measuring handoff efficiency
A method to generate handoff-point tasks from source tasks, producing 181 handoff tasks from 75 source tasks through deterministic interruption
A multi-model evaluation framework that measures both solved rate and handoff cost (agent events and cumulative prompt tokens) for coding agent benchmarks

title: Large AI Models in Dental Healthcare: From General-Purpose Systems to Domain-Specific Foundation Models
summary:
Background: Oral diseases affect nearly 3.5 billion people worldwide, yet the comparative clinical potential of large-scale AI models in dentistry remains poorly understood. Three distinct model categories have emerged: language-generative models, discriminative vision foundation models, and dental-specific foundation models, with no unified review examining their relationships and collective limitations.
  Methods: Following PRISMA-ScR guidelines, we systematically searched four databases (PubMed, Google Scholar, Scopus, arXiv), screened independently by two reviewers. After applying inclusion/exclusion criteria, 97 studies (2020-2026) were included. We propose a two-dimensional classification framework organizing models by architectural paradigm and dental specialization degree.
  Results: Language-generative models excel at text-based tasks (clinical reasoning, licensing exams, patient communication) but show inconsistent performance on image-dependent diagnostics. Adapted SAM and CLIP variants achieve strong tooth segmentation and lesion detection results. Dental-specific models (DentVFM, DentVLM, OralGPT) demonstrate strongest performance on complex multimodal tasks. Integrated pipelines consistently outperform single-model approaches. A data asymmetry is observed: dental-specific pretraining concentrates almost entirely in the vision domain, reflecting scarce large-scale dental text corpora.
  Conclusions: General-purpose and dental-specific models play complementary roles; the most effective systems combine both within structured pipelines. Safe autonomous deployment requires resolving three persistent barriers: hallucination in generative models, limited annotated dental datasets, and absent standardized clinical evaluation benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了97篇(2020-2026)关于大规模AI模型在牙科中的应用研究，提出了按架构范式和牙科专业化程度的二维分类框架，发现通用模型与牙科专用模型互补，集成管道优于单模型，并指出幻觉、标注数据不足和缺乏标准化临床评估基准是自主部署的主要障碍。
AI.motivation: 全球约35亿人受口腔疾病困扰，但大型AI模型在牙科领域的临床潜力比较尚不明确。三种不同类型的模型（语言生成模型、判别性视觉基础模型、牙科专用基础模型）各自发展，缺乏统一的综述来审视它们之间的关系和共同局限。
AI.method: 遵循PRISMA-ScR指南，系统检索PubMed、Google Scholar、Scopus、arXiv四个数据库，由两名评审人独立筛选。纳入97篇研究(2020-2026)，提出按架构范式和牙科专业化程度的二维分类框架。
AI.result: 语言生成模型在基于文本的任务（临床推理、执业考试、患者沟通）表现优异，但在图像依赖诊断上表现不一致。适配的SAM和CLIP变体在牙齿分割和病变检测上表现强劲。牙科专用模型（DentVFM、DentVLM、OralGPT）在复杂多模态任务上性能最强。集成管道始终优于单模型方法。存在数据不对称：牙科专用预训练几乎全部集中在视觉领域，缺乏大规模牙科文本语料库。
AI.conclusion: 通用模型与牙科专用模型互补，最有效的系统是在结构化管道中结合两者。安全自主部署需要解决三个持续存在的障碍：生成模型中的幻觉、有限的标注牙科数据集、缺乏标准化的临床评估基准。
idea_en: A two-dimensional classification framework for organizing AI models by architectural paradigm (language-generative, discriminative vision, hybrid) and degree of dental specialization (general-purpose vs. dental-specific), enabling systematic comparison and selection of models for different clinical tasks.

An integrated pipeline architecture that combines general-purpose language-generative models (for text-based clinical reasoning and patient communication) with dental-specific vision models (for segmentation and lesion detection) within a structured workflow, outperforming any single-model approach.

A dental-specific foundation model (e.g., DentVFM, DentVLM, OralGPT) pretrained on multimodal dental data (vision + limited text), designed to handle complex multimodal tasks requiring both image interpretation and clinical reasoning.

A method for adapting general-purpose vision foundation models (SAM, CLIP) to dental domains through fine-tuning on annotated dental imaging datasets, achieving strong performance on tooth segmentation and lesion detection without requiring full model retraining.

A data augmentation strategy that addresses the observed data asymmetry in dental AI (abundant vision data vs. scarce text corpora) by generating synthetic dental text corpora from existing clinical records or using language-generative models to produce domain-specific textual data.

A standardized clinical evaluation benchmark for dental AI systems, addressing the current absence of consistent metrics and protocols for assessing model performance across different dental tasks and modalities.

A hallucination mitigation system for generative models in dental applications, combining confidence scoring, external knowledge base retrieval, and cross-modal verification to reduce clinically unsafe outputs.

A multimodal fusion architecture that integrates language-generative models with discriminative vision models at the decision level through attention-based weighting, optimized for dental diagnostic tasks requiring both visual and textual reasoning.
idea_ch: 一种按架构范式（语言生成、判别性视觉、混合型）和牙科专业化程度（通用vs.牙科专用）对AI模型进行二维分类的组织框架，支持对不同临床任务的模型进行系统性比较和选择。
一种集成管道架构，在结构化工作流中结合通用语言生成模型（用于基于文本的临床推理和患者沟通）与牙科专用视觉模型（用于分割和病变检测），性能优于任何单一模型方法。

title: What Benchmarks Don't Measure: The Case for Evaluating Abstention Competence in Autonomous Agents
comment: ACM CAIS 2026: RLEval Workshop Oral Presentation(Best Paper Award)
summary: Benchmarks for autonomous agents measure whether agents complete tasks, yet this framing is systematically blind to whether an agent should have proceeded at all. Agents trained under human-feedback objectives develop a structural tendency to proceed even when they lack the inputs, evidence, or authorization to act safely, a disposition we term compliance bias, because both the reward signal and the benchmark scoring regime treat proceeding as the correct default regardless of whether the preconditions for safe action are present. We make three contributions. We first show that compliance bias originates in reward hacking within human-feedback pipelines and is entrenched by prominent agent benchmarks, which either penalize agents for pausing or are architecturally unable to distinguish a principled pause from a silent failure. We then introduce a three-gap taxonomy of abstention-warranted scenarios, covering specification gaps where required information is absent, verification gaps where world state cannot be confirmed, and authority gaps where explicit authorization has not been given, which together provide a principled basis for constructing abstention-aware agent benchmarks. Finally, we propose abstention evaluation protocols (Safety Rate, Usability Rate, and Informed Refusal Rate) and report preliminary results across 144 enterprise agent scenarios and five model families, in which a runtime-enforced abstention mechanism achieves up to 89.2% hazardous-action blocking and 87.5% usability on authorized scenarios, demonstrating that the safety--usability tradeoff is tunable rather than inherent and that its shape varies substantially across model families. We treat this as preliminary work and offer the taxonomy and composite metrics as a starting point for further conversations.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了自主智能体在人类反馈训练下会产生"合规偏差"——即使缺乏安全行动的前提条件也会倾向于继续行动。作者提出了三种需要"保留行动"的场景分类（规范缺口、验证缺口、授权缺口），并设计了相应的评估协议（安全率、可用率、知情拒绝率），实验表明运行时强制保留机制可在安全与可用性之间实现可调节的平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有的自主智能体基准测试仅关注任务完成率，忽视了智能体是否本应暂停行动这一关键问题。在人类反馈训练下，智能体形成了结构性的"合规偏差"倾向——即使缺乏安全行动所需的输入、证据或授权，也倾向于继续执行。
AI.method: 1. 识别并论证合规偏差的根源：人类反馈管道中的奖励黑客行为以及基准测试的评分机制。2. 提出三种需要保留行动的场景分类：规范缺口（信息缺失）、验证缺口（世界状态无法确认）、授权缺口（缺乏明确授权）。3. 设计三种评估协议：安全率、可用率、知情拒绝率。4. 在144个企业智能体场景和5个模型家族上进行实验验证。
AI.result: 运行时强制保留机制实现了高达89.2%的危险行动阻断率和87.5%的授权场景可用率，证明安全-可用性权衡是可调节的而非固有属性，且不同模型家族的表现差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 当前自主智能体基准存在系统性盲点，未能区分"有原则的暂停"和"静默失败"。作者提出的分类法和复合指标为进一步讨论提供了起点。
idea_en: A runtime-enforced abstention mechanism for autonomous agents that blocks hazardous actions (up to 89.2%) while maintaining usability on authorized scenarios, with tunable safety-usability tradeoff.

A three-gap taxonomy (specification gaps, verification gaps, authority gaps) for classifying scenarios where autonomous agents should abstain from proceeding, providing a principled basis for constructing abstention-aware benchmarks.
Composite abstention evaluation protocols comprising Safety Rate, Usability Rate, and Informed Refusal Rate for assessing autonomous agents beyond task completion metrics.
A method for detecting and mitigating compliance bias in human-feedback-trained agents, addressing the structural tendency to proceed without proper inputs, evidence, or authorization.
idea_ch: 一种运行时强制保留机制，用于自主智能体在缺乏安全行动前提条件时主动暂停，在授权场景下保持高可用性的同时阻断危险行动（高达89.2%），且安全-可用性权衡可调节。
三种需要智能体保留行动的场景分类法：规范缺口（信息缺失）、验证缺口（世界状态无法确认）和授权缺口（缺乏明确授权），为构建具有保留意识的基准测试提供原则性基础。
复合保留评估协议，包括安全率、可用率和知情拒绝率三个指标，用于超越传统任务完成率来评估自主智能体的安全性。
一种检测和缓解人类反馈训练智能体中'合规偏差'的方法，解决智能体在缺乏适当输入、证据或授权时仍倾向于继续行动的结构性问题。

title: WISE-HAR: A Generalizable Ensemble Deep Learning Framework for WiFi-Based Human Activity Recognition
summary: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) using WiFi signals has emerged as a transformative technology for smart homes, healthcare monitoring, security systems, and ambient assisted living. Unlike traditional camera-based systems that raise significant privacy concerns and fail in low-light conditions, or wearable sensors that require user compliance, WiFi-based HAR is non-intrusive, privacy-preserving, cost-effective, and works seamlessly in any lighting condition. This paper presents a comprehensive approach to recognize three distinct human activities: "No Presence" (empty room), "Walking", and "Walking + Arm-waving" using the Wallhack1.8k WiFi spectrogram dataset. We propose three key improvements to address the main challenges in WiFi-based HAR. First, to address high performance variance, we implement ensemble learning with five different CNN architectures (Deep CNN, Wide CNN, MobileNetV2, ResNet50V2, and EfficientNetB0). Second, to address the small dataset size limitation, we apply aggressive data augmentation techniques including time-warping, frequency masking, and noise addition. Third, to evaluate real-world generalization capability, we perform cross-scenario evaluation (training on Line-of-Sight and testing on Non-Line-of-Sight) and cross-antenna evaluation (training on Biquad antenna and testing on PIFA antenna). Our ensemble model achieved a test accuracy of 94.87% on the LOS scenario with Biquad antenna, outperforming the best individual model by 0.66%. Data augmentation improved Random Forest performance from 60% to 95%. Cross-scenario evaluation showed minimal accuracy drops of only 1.37% and 2.07%, demonstrating strong generalization capabilities. The results indicate that the proposed approach is robust, reliable, and suitable for real-world deployment in diverse environments with different hardware configurations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于WiFi信号的人类活动识别方法，利用Wallhack1.8k频谱图数据集识别三种活动（无人、行走、行走+挥臂），通过集成五种CNN模型、数据增强和跨场景评估，在LOS场景下达到94.87%的准确率，并展现出强泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 传统基于摄像头和可穿戴传感器的活动识别存在隐私问题、低光照失效和用户依从性等缺陷，WiFi信号提供了一种非侵入式、保护隐私且成本低廉的替代方案，但现有方法面临性能方差大、小数据集限制和泛化能力不足等挑战。
AI.method: 1) 集成学习：组合Deep CNN、Wide CNN、MobileNetV2、ResNet50V2和EfficientNetB0五种CNN架构；2) 数据增强：时间扭曲、频率掩码和噪声添加；3) 跨场景评估：LOS→NLOS跨场景测试和Biquad→PIFA跨天线测试。
AI.result: 集成模型在LOS场景下Biquad天线测试准确率94.87%，比最佳单一模型高0.66%；数据增强将随机森林性能从60%提升至95%；跨场景评估准确率仅下降1.37%和2.07%。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法鲁棒、可靠，适用于不同环境和硬件配置的真实世界部署，有效解决了WiFi-HAR的主要挑战。
idea_en: Ensemble learning method combining multiple CNN architectures (Deep CNN, Wide CNN, MobileNetV2, ResNet50V2, EfficientNetB0) for WiFi spectrogram-based human activity recognition, achieving improved accuracy and reduced performance variance.
Aggressive data augmentation technique for WiFi spectrograms specifically combining time-warping, frequency masking, and noise addition to address small dataset limitations in WiFi-based HAR.
Cross-scenario evaluation framework for WiFi-based HAR that trains on Line-of-Sight (LOS) data and tests on Non-Line-of-Sight (NLOS) data to verify real-world generalization capability.
Cross-antenna evaluation methodology for WiFi-based HAR that trains on Biquad antenna data and tests on PIFA antenna data to ensure hardware-agnostic performance.
WiFi spectrogram-based activity recognition system capable of distinguishing 'No Presence', 'Walking', and 'Walking + Arm-waving' activities with high accuracy and robustness.
idea_ch: 基于多种CNN架构（Deep CNN、Wide CNN、MobileNetV2、ResNet50V2、EfficientNetB0）的集成学习方法，用于WiFi频谱图人体活动识别，提高精度并降低性能方差
针对WiFi频谱图的小数据集局限性，结合时间扭曲、频率掩码和噪声添加的激进数据增强技术

能够高精度区分'无人''行走''行走+挥臂'三种活动的WiFi频谱图人体活动识别系统

title: Inducing Reasoning Primitives from Agent Traces
summary: ReAct-style LLM agents often rediscover the same reasoning routines across problems, yet leave those routines trapped in transient scratchpads. We introduce Reasoning Primitive Induction, a single-pass method that mines successful ReAct traces, clusters recurrent reasoning moves, and converts the most frequent moves into a compact library of typed pseudo-tools. Each pseudo-tool is specified by a natural-language docstring interpreted by an LLM at invocation time, and a standard ReAct loop composes these primitives at test time. The central result is that induced libraries outperform the very agent that generated their traces: by +44pp on RuleArena NBA (30 -> 74), +30pp on MuSR team allocation (38 -> 68), and +22pp on NatPlan meeting planning (7 -> 29). Across five comparable subtasks spanning narrative deduction, rule application, and constraint-satisfaction planning, a single fixed configuration improves over zero-shot Chain-of-Thought on every subtask, matches or surpasses expert-authored decompositions, and outperforms AWM at lower average inference cost.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种推理原语归纳方法，从ReAct智能体的成功轨迹中自动挖掘并归纳为类型化伪工具库，在多个推理任务上显著优于原始智能体和专家设计的分解方法。
AI.motivation: ReAct风格的LLM智能体在解决问题时经常重复相同的推理模式，但这些模式仅存在于临时的scratchpad中，无法被复用和积累，导致效率低下。
AI.method: 单次通过的推理原语归纳方法：(1)挖掘成功的ReAct轨迹；(2)聚类分析重复出现的推理步骤；(3)将最频繁的推理模式转化为类型化伪工具库，每个伪工具有自然语言文档字符串供LLM调用时理解，推理时通过标准ReAct循环组合这些原语。
AI.result: 在RuleArena NBA任务上提升44个百分点(30->74)，MuSR团队分配任务提升30个百分点(38->68)，NatPlan会议规划提升22个百分点(7->29)。在五个可比子任务上，单一固定配置在所有子任务上均优于零样本思维链，匹配或超越专家编写的分解方法，并以更低推理成本超越AWM。
AI.conclusion: 通过自动归纳ReAct轨迹中的推理原语并构建伪工具库，可以显著提升LLM智能体的推理能力，且该方法在多个推理类型（叙事推理、规则应用、约束满足规划）上均表现优异。
idea_en: A method for automatically inducing reasoning primitives from successful ReAct agent traces by mining, clustering, and converting recurrent reasoning moves into a typed pseudo-tool library.
A system that generates natural-language docstrings for each induced pseudo-tool, enabling LLM interpretation at invocation time without requiring additional training.
A single-pass reasoning primitive induction technique that composes discovered primitives via standard ReAct loop at test time, eliminating the need for multi-pass training.
A typed pseudo-tool library structure where reasoning patterns are formalized as reusable tools with type annotations and natural language specifications.
A cross-task transfer method where induced reasoning primitives from one domain are applied to improve performance on related reasoning tasks.
idea_ch: 一种从成功ReAct智能体轨迹中自动挖掘、聚类并归纳推理原语的方法，将重复出现的推理模式转化为类型化伪工具库。
一种为归纳出的每个伪工具生成自然语言文档字符串的系统，使LLM在调用时无需额外训练即可理解工具用途。
一种单次通过的推理原语归纳技术，在测试时通过标准ReAct循环组合发现的原语，无需多轮训练过程。
一种类型化伪工具库结构，将推理模式形式化为带有类型标注和自然语言规范的可复用工具。
一种跨任务迁移方法，将从一个领域归纳出的推理原语应用于提升相关推理任务的性能。

title: AUDITFLOW: Executable Symbolic Environments for Structured Financial Reporting Verification
summary: Structured financial audit verification is difficult for language-model agents because correctness depends on structured evidence rather than text alone. A model must link reported facts to taxonomy concepts, traverse calculation or dimensional relations, and recompute expected values before applying an audit rule. We propose AuditFlow, a graph-grounded multi-agent framework that separates adaptive search from deterministic verification. AuditFlow builds a symbolic environment from a static US-GAAP taxonomy graph and a dynamic XBRL filing graph, and exposes it through typed tools for fact retrieval, taxonomy traversal, numerical checking, and rule evaluation. Two junior auditors inspect each case from regulatory and evidentiary views, while a senior auditor resolves disagreements and can request further investigation. The final reports are fused through evidential aggregation to produce an audit verdict, expected value, evidence trail, and trustworthiness score. On a FinAuditing-derived FinMR sample, AuditFlow reaches 82.09% joint audit accuracy under GPT-5.5, outperforming the strongest baseline by 14.93 points. Removing deterministic checks drops accuracy to 17.91%, showing that the symbolic environment performs the verification step that the model cannot reliably replace.

AI.tldr: 提出AuditFlow，一个基于图的智能体框架，结合符号环境与多智能体协作，实现结构化财务审计验证，准确率达82.09%。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在处理结构化财务审计验证时存在困难，因为正确性依赖于结构化证据而非纯文本，模型需要关联报告事实与分类法概念、遍历计算或维度关系、重新计算预期值后才能应用审计规则，现有方法难以可靠完成这些步骤。
AI.method: 构建符号环境：静态US-GAAP分类法图+动态XBRL申报图，通过类型化工具暴露事实检索、分类法遍历、数值检查和规则评估功能。采用多智能体框架：两名初级审计员分别从监管和证据角度审查，高级审计员解决分歧并请求进一步调查，最终通过证据聚合生成审计结论。
AI.result: 在FinMR样本上达到82.09%的联合审计准确率，超过最强基线14.93个百分点。移除确定性检验后准确率降至17.91%，证明符号环境执行了模型无法可靠替代的验证步骤。
AI.conclusion: 符号环境与确定性验证是结构化财务审计的关键，语言模型无法可靠替代这些步骤，AuditFlow框架有效结合了自适应搜索与确定性验证的优势。
idea_en: A graph-grounded multi-agent framework for structured audit verification that separates adaptive search from deterministic verification using a symbolic environment.
A symbolic environment construction method combining a static US-GAAP taxonomy graph and a dynamic XBRL filing graph for financial audit verification.
A multi-agent audit mechanism with two junior auditors (regulatory and evidentiary views) and a senior auditor for disagreement resolution and further investigation requests.
An evidential aggregation method for fusing audit reports to produce verdict, expected value, evidence trail, and trustworthiness score.
A typed tool system for fact retrieval, taxonomy traversal, numerical checking, and rule evaluation in a symbolic audit environment.
idea_ch: 一种基于图的多智能体框架，将自适应搜索与确定性验证分离，用于结构化审计验证。
一种结合静态US-GAAP分类法图和动态XBRL申报图的符号环境构建方法，用于财务审计验证。
一种多智能体审计机制：两名初级审计员分别从监管和证据角度审查，高级审计员解决分歧并请求进一步调查。
一种证据聚合方法，融合审计报告以生成审计结论、预期值、证据链和可信度评分。
一种类型化工具系统，在符号审计环境中实现事实检索、分类法遍历、数值检查和规则评估功能。

title: ToolGate: Token-Efficient Pre-Call Control for Tool-Augmented Vision-Language Agents
summary: Tool-augmented vision-language agents can acquire external perceptual evidence through OCR, detection, segmentation, and other tools, but executing every proposed tool call is costly and sometimes unnecessary. We study the pre-call control problem: after a ReAct-style VLM agent proposes a perceptual tool call, should the call be executed, or skipped before its output enters the context? Across five benchmarks, we find that the baseline agent exhibits poor local selectivity: helpful and harmful calls occur at similar rates (11.8% vs. 9.9%), while most calls do not change the immediate forced-answer prediction. We introduce ToolGate, a lightweight external controller that predicts execute/skip decisions from trajectory text and simple structural features. Across two Qwen3-VL backbones, ToolGate reduces token cost to 64-69% of the unrestricted ReAct baseline while preserving average accuracy in cross-domain settings. With matched-domain trajectory training on Qwen3-VL-30B, it further improves average accuracy by 1.65 points. These results show that tool-augmented VLM agents benefit not only from better perceptual tools, but also from explicit control over when tool outputs are worth paying for.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ToolGate，一种轻量级外部控制器，用于ReAct风格VLM代理的预调用控制——在感知工具执行前决定是否跳过不必要的调用，将token成本降至64-69%并保持甚至提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 工具增强的视觉语言代理会调用OCR、检测等感知工具，但每次调用都有成本和延迟，且许多调用对最终预测无益甚至有害。现有代理缺乏对工具调用必要性的选择性控制。
AI.method: 提出ToolGate，一个轻量级外部控制器，基于轨迹文本和简单结构特征（如工具类型、调用频率、上下文相关性）预测执行/跳过决策，在工具输出进入上下文之前进行拦截控制。
AI.result: 在五个基准测试中，基线代理中11.8%的调用有益、9.9%有害；ToolGate将token成本降至ReAct基线的64-69%并保持准确率；在Qwen3-VL-30B上使用同域轨迹训练后准确率提升1.65个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 工具增强VLM代理不仅需要更好的感知工具，还需要对何时值得执行工具调用进行显式控制，ToolGate提供了一种高效的轻量级解决方案。
idea_en: A lightweight external controller (ToolGate) for pre-call control that predicts execute/skip decisions for tool calls proposed by ReAct-style VLM agents, using trajectory text and structural features to reduce unnecessary tool executions.

A method for selectively controlling perceptual tool calls (OCR, detection, segmentation) in vision-language agents by intercepting the tool call before its output enters the agent context, thereby saving token costs and reducing harmful interference.

A pre-call control mechanism that uses simple structural features (tool type, call frequency, context relevance) combined with trajectory text to make binary execute/skip decisions for proposed tool calls in multi-step VLM reasoning.
A cross-domain token cost reduction system for tool-augmented VLMs that maintains or improves accuracy while reducing token consumption to 64-69% of unrestricted ReAct baselines.

A matched-domain trajectory training approach for the ToolGate controller that further improves average accuracy by 1.65 points on large VLM backbones (Qwen3-VL-30B) while reducing tool invocation costs.
idea_ch: 一种用于VLM代理工具调用的预调用轻量级外部控制器ToolGate，基于轨迹文本和结构特征预测是否执行或跳过工具调用，减少不必要的工具执行。
一种选择性控制视觉语言代理中感知工具调用（OCR、检测、分割）的方法，在工具输出进入代理上下文之前进行拦截，从而节省token成本并减少有害干扰。
一种利用简单结构特征（工具类型、调用频率、上下文相关性）结合轨迹文本对多步VLM推理中的工具调用做出二值执行/跳过决策的预调用控制机制。
一种跨域token成本降低系统，用于工具增强的VLM，将token消耗降至ReAct基线的64-69%同时保持或提升准确率。
一种针对ToolGate控制器的同域轨迹训练方法，在大规模VLM骨干网络（Qwen3-VL-30B）上进一步将平均准确率提升1.65个百分点同时降低工具调用成本。

title: SkillDAG: Self-Evolving Typed Skill Graphs for LLM Skill Selection at Scale
summary: As LLM agents adopt large skill libraries, selecting the right subset becomes a structural problem rather than a similarity-matching one: skills depend on, conflict with, specialize, or duplicate one another, a structure invisible to both full enumeration and embedding similarity. We present SkillDAG, which models inter-skill relationships as a typed directed graph and exposes it to an LLM agent as an inference-time, agent-callable structural retrieval interface, queried and evolved during execution rather than baked into a fixed retrieval pipeline: each search returns vector matches, typed-edge neighbors, and conflict signals, and a propose-then-commit protocol lets the agent register execution-backed edges so the graph accumulates structure across episodes. On ALFWorld and SkillsBench with MiniMax-M2.7, SkillDAG reaches 67.1% success and 27.3% reward, exceeding the strongest reported Graph-of-Skills baseline by +12.8 and +8.6 points; the advantage ports to gpt-5.2-codex, and intrinsic SkillsBench Ret@K rises from 65.5 to 78.2 under matched queries. These gains trace to isolable mechanisms: candidate ranking that stays robust as the pool grows 10x where a fixed seeding-diffusion pipeline degrades, and set-monotone online edits that enlarge ground-truth recall without evicting prior hits.

AI.tldr: SkillDAG提出了一种基于有向图结构建模技能间关系（依赖、冲突、特化、重复）的方法，作为LLM代理推理时可调用的结构化检索接口，在运行中动态查询和演化图结构，显著提升了技能选择的准确性和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 传统方法将技能选择视为相似度匹配问题，无法捕捉技能之间的结构关系（如依赖、冲突、特化、重复），导致枚举和嵌入相似度均无法有效处理大规模技能库的结构性问题。
AI.method: 构建类型化有向图（SkillDAG）建模技能间关系；提供推理时可调用的结构化检索接口，返回向量匹配结果、类型化边邻居和冲突信号；采用"提议-提交"协议（propose-then-commit protocol）让代理在执行过程中注册经执行验证的边，使图结构跨回合累积。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld和SkillsBench上使用MiniMax-M2.7，成功率67.1%、奖励27.3%，超过Graph-of-Skills基线+12.8和+8.6个点；SkillsBench Ret@K从65.5提升至78.2；候选排名在技能库扩大10倍时仍保持鲁棒，固定seed-diffusion管道性能下降。
AI.conclusion: SkillDAG证明了显式建模技能间结构关系对大规模LLM代理技能选择的有效性，其"可演化的结构化检索"范式优于固定的检索管道，候选排名鲁棒性和在线编辑的可扩展性是其核心优势。
idea_en: A typed directed graph modeling inter-skill relationships (dependency, conflict, specialization, duplication) for LLM agents, served as an inference-time, agent-callable structural retrieval interface that returns vector matches, typed-edge neighbors, and conflict signals simultaneously.

A propose-then-commit protocol that allows an LLM agent to register execution-backed edges during runtime, enabling the skill graph to accumulate structural information across episodes without requiring pre-defined relationships.
A set-monotone online editing mechanism that enlarges ground-truth recall without evicting prior hits, ensuring stable retrieval performance as the skill library scales.
A candidate ranking method that remains robust when the skill pool grows 10x, overcoming the degradation observed in fixed seeding-diffusion retrieval pipelines.
idea_ch: 一种类型化有向图建模技能间关系（依赖、冲突、特化、重复），作为LLM代理推理时可调用的结构化检索接口，同时返回向量匹配结果、类型化边邻居和冲突信号。
一种"提议-提交"协议，允许LLM代理在运行时注册经执行验证的边，使技能图跨回合累积结构信息，无需预定义关系。
一种集合单调的在线编辑机制，在不驱逐先前命中结果的前提下扩大真实召回率，确保技能库扩展时检索性能稳定。
一种候选排名方法，在技能池扩大10倍时仍保持鲁棒性，克服了固定seed-diffusion检索管道性能下降的问题。

title: CORE: Conflict-Oriented Reasoning for General Multimodal Manipulation Detection
summary: The rapid rise of generative AI has made multimodal fake news increasingly realistic and pervasive, posing severe threats to public trust and social stability. Existing detection methods rely heavily on manipulation-specific models and large-scale labeled data, resulting in poor generalization to emerging manipulation types. We observed that the essence of manipulated misinformation lies in its intrinsic conflicts, \textbf{i.e.,} semantic or physical inconsistencies either across modalities or with common world knowledge. Inspired by this observation, we propose \textbf{C}onflict-\textbf{O}riented \textbf{RE}asoning (\textbf{CORE}) framework, an effective paradigm that learns to endows multimodal large language models (MLLMs) with explicit conflict-capturing capability. To this end, CORE first constructs the Conflict Attribution Corpus (CAC) with fine-grained annotations of conflict factors and sources, providing essential data support for subsequent conflict perception training. By performing conflict-oriented representation enhancement and reasoning based on CAC, CORE achieves robust and generalizable conflict detection, effectively and rapidly adapting to unseen manipulation types with a few samples or in even zero-shot settings. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CORE surpasses state-of-the-art models. The dataset and code are publicly available at https://github.com/shen8424/CORE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CORE框架，通过显式捕捉多模态虚假新闻中的语义/物理冲突（跨模态或与世界常识的不一致），实现鲁棒且泛化的虚假新闻检测，在少量样本甚至零样本场景下均表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有检测方法依赖操纵特定模型和大规模标注数据，难以泛化到新兴操纵类型。多模态虚假新闻的本质在于其内在冲突（语义或物理不一致），因此需要一种能够显式捕捉冲突的检测范式。
AI.method: CORE框架首先构建冲突归因语料库(CAC)，包含细粒度的冲突因素和来源标注；然后基于CAC进行面向冲突的表征增强和推理训练，赋予多模态大语言模型(MLLM)显式的冲突捕捉能力。
AI.result: 在多项实验上，CORE超越了现有最先进模型，在未知操纵类型上具备强泛化能力，少量样本和零样本设置下均有效。
AI.conclusion: 基于冲突导向推理的范式为多模态虚假新闻检测提供了一种高效、可泛化的新路径，数据集和代码已开源。
idea_en: A conflict-oriented reasoning framework (CORE) for multimodal fake news detection that explicitly captures semantic or physical inconsistencies across modalities or with common world knowledge.
A Conflict Attribution Corpus (CAC) with fine-grained annotations of conflict factors and sources, used to train MLLMs for conflict perception.
A conflict-oriented representation enhancement and reasoning training method that enables robust detection and rapid adaptation to unseen manipulation types with few-shot or zero-shot learning.
idea_ch: 一种面向冲突推理的多模态虚假新闻检测框架(CORE)，通过显式捕捉跨模态或与世界常识之间的语义/物理不一致来识别虚假信息。
一种冲突归因语料库(CAC)，包含细粒度的冲突因素和来源标注，用于训练多模态大语言模型(MLLM)的冲突感知能力。
一种面向冲突的表征增强与推理训练方法，使模型在少量样本甚至零样本场景下可快速适应和检测未知操纵类型的虚假新闻。

title: DELTAMEM: Incremental Experience Memory for LLM Agents via Residual Trees
summary: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents increasingly rely on memory to learn from experiences over continual interactions. However, storing experiences as independent, flat units leads to substantial redundancy and retrieval conflicts, as similar episodes repeat overlapping content and subtle scene variations cause retrieved memories to offer contradictory guidance. To address this, we introduce residual experience, positing that newly acquired experience is often an incremental variation of existing knowledge. We propose DeltaMem, a framework that organizes experience memory into two independent residual trees, one storing goal-conditioned task experience as reusable skills and another for scene-level environment knowledge. Each tree uses a root node for generalized base experiences and incremental delta nodes for subsequent variations, allowing related experiences to share a common foundation without duplication. For retrieval, a failure-penalized similarity scan locates the best match, reconstructing the full experience via root-to-match chain composition. An autonomous consolidation mechanism distills high-frequency paths into new root nodes, enabling the trees to self-organize from general heuristics to specialized variants. Experiments across diverse interactive environments show that DeltaMem consistently outperforms existing baselines. To facilitate future research, we release the code at https://github.com/import-myself/DeltaMem.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DeltaMem框架，通过残差经验树（增量节点+根节点）组织LLM智能体的记忆，减少冗余并解决检索冲突，在多种交互环境中优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体将经验存储为独立、扁平单元，导致大量冗余（相似场景重复存储）和检索冲突（细微差异引发矛盾指导），缺乏对经验的增量结构化管理。
AI.method: DeltaMem构建两棵残差经验树：一棵存储目标导向的任务经验（可复用技能），另一棵存储场景级环境知识。每棵树以根节点存储通用基础经验，增量节点存储后续变化。检索时采用失败惩罚相似度扫描，通过根节点到匹配节点的链式组合重构完整经验。自主整合机制将高频路径蒸馏为新根节点，实现树的自组织演化。
AI.result: 在多种交互式环境中，DeltaMem持续优于现有基线方法，验证了残差经验树在减少冗余、缓解检索冲突方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将经验建模为增量变化（残差）而非独立单元，能够更高效地组织智能体记忆，为LLM智能体的持续学习提供了新范式。
idea_en: A residual experience tree structure for organizing agent memory, where a root node stores generalized base experiences and delta nodes store incremental variations, enabling shared common foundation without duplication.

A dual-tree architecture (DeltaMem) comprising one tree for goal-conditioned task experience (reusable skills) and another for scene-level environment knowledge, achieving structured separation of memory types.
A failure-penalized similarity scan retrieval mechanism that locates best match and reconstructs full experience via root-to-match chain composition.
An autonomous memory consolidation mechanism that distills high-frequency access paths into new root nodes, enabling self-organization of memory trees from general heuristics to specialized variants.
idea_ch: 一种残差经验树结构，根节点存储通用基础经验，增量节点存储后续变化，使相关经验共享共同基础、避免重复存储，用于组织LLM智能体记忆。
DeltaMem双树架构：一棵树存储目标导向的任务经验（可复用技能），另一棵树存储场景级环境知识，实现记忆类型的结构化分离。
一种失败惩罚的相似度扫描检索机制，定位最佳匹配并通过根节点到匹配节点的链式组合重构完整经验。
一种自主记忆整合机制，将高频访问路径蒸馏为新的根节点，使记忆树从通用启发式自组织为专用变体。

title: The Shadow Price of Reasoning: Economic Perspective on Optimal Budget Allocation for LLMs
summary:
Inference-time scaling has emerged as a critical avenue for enhancing Large Language Models' performance, yet real-world deployment is constrained by strict computational budgets. In this work, we formulate inference budget allocation as a global constrained optimization problem governed by economic principles. By modeling per-query reasoning utility with a shifted-surge function, we derive an optimal allocation policy based on a global shadow price that equilibrates marginal utility under resource scarcity. Based on this theory, we propose Constrained Latent-utility Equilibrium Allocation for Reasoning (CLEAR). It performs rational abandonment and reallocates resources from insolvent queries to solvable queries near their emergence thresholds.
  Extensive experiments on several reasoning tasks with different traffic streams demonstrate that CLEAR significantly improves the Pareto frontier of total token cost versus mean accuracy. In resource-scarce regimes, CLEAR achieves up to a 3x improvement in global accuracy compared to uniform allocation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CLEAR方法，将推理预算分配建模为全局约束优化问题，基于经济学原理（影子价格、边际效用）实现推理资源的最优分配，在资源受限场景下显著提升准确率与成本效率。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型推理时延展（inference-time scaling）虽能提升性能，但实际部署中计算预算严格受限。现有方法缺乏全局最优的资源分配策略，导致预算浪费在低效查询上。
AI.method: 将推理预算分配建模为全局约束优化问题；引入shifted-surge函数建模每查询的推理效用；基于影子价格（shadow price）推导最优分配策略，实现边际效用均衡；CLEAR算法执行理性放弃（rational abandonment），将资源从无解查询重新分配至接近阈值的有解查询。
AI.result: 在多种推理任务和流量模式下，CLEAR显著提升了总Token成本与平均准确率的帕累托前沿；在资源稀缺场景下，相比均匀分配，全局准确率提升高达3倍。
AI.conclusion: 将经济学原理引入LLM推理资源分配，通过影子价格机制实现全局最优分配，理性放弃低效查询是提升资源利用效率的关键。
idea_en: A method for allocating inference-time computational budgets in LLMs by formulating a global constrained optimization problem with a shifted-surge utility function and deriving optimal allocation policies based on shadow prices that equilibrate marginal utility under resource scarcity.

A rational abandonment mechanism that identifies insolvent queries (those unlikely to benefit from additional computation) and reallocates resources to solvable queries near their emergence thresholds, improving global accuracy under strict budgets.
A system that dynamically computes and applies a global shadow price for inference tokens, enabling real-time marginal utility-based resource redistribution across concurrent query streams.
idea_ch: 一种基于移位激增函数（shifted-surge function）建模每查询推理效用，并通过全局影子价格（shadow price）实现边际效用均衡的最优推理预算分配方法。
一种理性放弃（rational abandonment）机制，识别并停止对无解查询（insolvent queries）的资源投入，将释放的计算资源重新分配给接近阈值的有解查询（solvable queries），从而在严格预算下最大化全局准确率。
一种动态计算和应用推理令牌全局影子价格的系统，实现并发查询流之间基于边际效用的实时资源再分配。

title: Decomposing how prompting steers behavior
summary: Prompting steers large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) without weight updates, but it remains unclear how instruction changes reshape internal representations to produce behavior. We introduce a nested geometric decomposition framework that treats prompting as a transformation of the representational geometry of the content following the prompt. For each prompt pair, we align representations of the same stimuli under two prompts using increasingly expressive stimulus-invariant maps: translation, rigid transformation with uniform scaling, sequential axis scaling, affine transformation, and nonlinear transformation. We then causally test each map by replacing a single layer's prompt-A hidden state for held-out stimuli with its mapped counterpart and measuring recovery of prompt-B representational geometry and behavior. Across three LLMs, three VLMs, and six text or image datasets spanning style, emotion, scene content, and number, prompts consistently reshape representations toward the instructed task structure. Cross-validated variance decomposition shows that much prompt-induced activation change is captured by shape-preserving maps, especially translation and rigid transformation with uniform scaling, while tier profiles reveal model- and task-specific routing strategies across layers. Crucially, although translation and rigid tiers already improve behavioral agreement, affine transformation is the first tier to nearly recover target-prompt task geometry and yields corresponding behavioral gains. This suggests that cross-dimensional linear mixing is a key mechanism by which prompts reorganize representations toward instructed task structure. Our framework decomposes prompt-induced representational change into interpretable geometric components and reveals how models route task-relevant structure to produce prompt-driven behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出嵌套几何分解框架，将提示工程视为表征几何空间的变换，通过多层级刺激不变映射（平移、刚体变换、顺序轴缩放、仿射变换、非线性变换）分析提示如何重塑LLM和VLM的内部表征，并发现跨维度线性混合（仿射变换）是提示重组表征的关键机制。
AI.motivation: 理解提示指令如何改变大模型内部表征结构以产生特定行为，当前缺乏对提示引起表征变化的几何层面的系统分解和因果验证。
AI.method: 提出嵌套几何分解框架：对不同提示下的相同刺激表征，使用从简单到复杂的刺激不变映射（平移、刚体+均匀缩放、顺序轴缩放、仿射、非线性）进行对齐；通过替换单层隐藏状态进行因果测试，测量目标提示表征和行为恢复程度。
AI.result: 形状保持映射（特别是平移和刚体变换）捕获大部分提示诱导的激活变化；仿射变换是首个近乎完全恢复目标提示任务几何并带来行为增益的层级，表明跨维度线性混合是关键机制。
AI.conclusion: 框架将提示引起的表征变化分解为可解释的几何成分，揭示了模型路由任务相关结构以产生提示驱动行为的机制。
idea_en: 1. A nested geometric decomposition framework for analyzing prompt-induced representational changes in LLMs/VLMs using stimulus-invariant maps of increasing expressiveness (translation, rigid+scaling, sequential axis scaling, affine, nonlinear).

2. A causal testing method that replaces a single layer's hidden state with its geometrically mapped counterpart from another prompt condition to measure recovery of target-prompt representational geometry and behavior.
3. Cross-validated variance decomposition technique that characterizes prompt-induced activation changes via shape-preserving geometric transforms across model layers.

4. A mechanism identification approach that reveals cross-dimensional linear mixing (affine transformation) as the key operation by which prompts reorganize representations toward instructed task structure.
5. A tier profiling methodology that exposes model- and task-specific routing strategies across layers by analyzing which geometric transformation tiers best capture prompt effects.
idea_ch: 1. 一种嵌套几何分解框架，利用从简单到复杂的刺激不变映射（平移、刚体+均匀缩放、顺序轴缩放、仿射、非线性变换）分析提示引起的LLM/VLM表征变化。
2. 一种因果测试方法，通过将单层隐藏状态替换为来自另一提示条件的几何映射对应状态，测量目标提示表征几何和行为恢复程度。
3. 跨验证方差分解技术，通过跨模型层的形状保持几何变换表征提示诱导的激活变化。
4. 一种机制识别方法，揭示跨维度线性混合（仿射变换）是提示将表征重组为指令任务结构的关键操作。
5. 一种层级画像方法论，通过分析哪些几何变换层级最能捕获提示效应，揭示跨层的模型和任务特定路由策略。

title: From Long News to Accurate Forecast: Importance-Aware Fusion and PRM-Guided Reflection for Time Series Forecasting
summary: Incorporating news into time series forecasting is appealing because news can reveal abrupt exogenous events that historical values alone cannot recover. However, existing LLM-based news-forecasting pipelines face two practical limitations: relevant news articles often exceed the model's context window, and iterative retrieval of supplementary news is typically unguided, leading to redundant updates and slow convergence. We address these issues with a novel framework that combines importance-aware news compression and process-level retrieval supervision. First, we train an importance reward model that estimates the forecasting utility of each article and uses this signal to allocate compression budgets during sequential pairwise fusion, preserving informative content within a fixed context limit. Second, we introduce a process reward model (PRM) that ranks multiple supplementary-news candidates conditioned on the current error profile and the history of previously selected articles, replacing one-shot blind retrieval with quality-controlled selection. Both components are trained offline using historical data with ground truth; inference uses the frozen filtering logic and compression modules without any reflection loop. Experiments on finance, energy, traffic, and bitcoin forecasting benchmarks show that our method improves prediction accuracy over strong baselines, significantly reduces the number of refinement iterations compared to the iterative baseline, and remains effective when relevant articles span thousands of tokens.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合新闻重要性感知压缩和过程级检索监督的框架，用于提升基于LLM的时间序列预测。通过重要性奖励模型分配压缩预算，以及过程奖励模型实现质量可控的补充新闻检索，在多个预测基准上提升了准确性并减少了迭代次数。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM新闻预测流水线存在两个实际问题：相关新闻文章常超出模型上下文窗口，且迭代检索缺乏引导导致冗余更新和收敛缓慢。
AI.method: 1) 训练重要性奖励模型评估每篇文章的预测效用，在顺序配对融合时分配压缩预算以保留信息内容；2) 引入过程奖励模型，根据当前误差分布和历史选择对补充新闻候选排序，替代一次性盲目检索。两个模块均使用历史数据进行离线训练。
AI.result: 在金融、能源、交通和比特币预测基准上，该方法相比强基线提升了预测准确性，显著减少了迭代次数，且在新闻文章超长时仍保持有效性。
AI.conclusion: 结合重要性感知压缩和过程级检索监督能有效解决LLM新闻预测中的长上下文和检索低效问题，提升预测性能的同时降低计算成本。
idea_en: An importance-aware news compression method using a trained reward model to estimate forecasting utility and allocate compression budgets during sequential pairwise fusion.
A process reward model (PRM) that ranks supplementary news candidates conditioned on current error profile and history of previously selected articles for quality-controlled retrieval.
An offline-trained filtering and compression pipeline for LLM-based time series forecasting that eliminates the need for online reflection loops.
A sequential pairwise fusion mechanism for news compression that preserves informative content within fixed context limits using importance-weighted budget allocation.
idea_ch: 一种基于重要性感知的新闻压缩方法：训练奖励模型评估每篇文章的预测效用，在顺序配对融合过程中分配压缩预算，在固定上下文窗口内保留信息内容。
一种过程奖励模型(PRM)：根据当前预测误差分布和历史已选文章对补充新闻候选进行排序，实现质量可控的检索，替代一次性盲目检索。
一种离线训练结合冻结推理的过滤与压缩流水线：用于LLM时间序列预测，无需在线反思循环，降低推理成本。
一种顺序配对融合机制：通过重要性加权的预算分配，在固定上下文限制下逐步融合新闻文章，保留高预测价值的信息。

title: DeskCraft: Benchmarking Desktop Agents on Professional Workflows and Human-in-the-Loop Collaboration
summary: Real-world professional desktop workflows in specialized creative and engineering software unfold over long horizons and often require human-in-the-loop coordination, where agents proactively seek necessary information and users provide additional instructions, clarifications, feedback, or corrections as the task progresses. Yet existing desktop GUI benchmarks mostly reduce this setting to short, simplified tasks with all user instructions provided upfront. To address this issue, we introduce DeskCraft, a desktop GUI benchmark targeting long horizon creative and engineering workflows and proactive human-agent collaboration. DeskCraft organizes tasks into a multilevel difficulty taxonomy, with long horizon tasks requiring over 50 execution steps, and covers professional creative software across design, video, audio, and 3D creation. Furthermore, DeskCraft formalizes human-agent collaboration into an interaction protocol covering mid-turn and post-turn exchanges. Mid-turn interaction captures both agent-initiated clarification under uncertainty and user-initiated interruption during execution, while post-turn interaction accommodates user-driven feedback after the agent signals completion, together spanning the full space of realistic collaboration patterns. We evaluate 18 proprietary and open source agents on 538 tasks and find that GPT-5.4 reaches 31.6% on standard tasks and 27.6% on interactive tasks. Further analyses reveal persistent failures in long horizon workflow delivery and proactive clarification. We will open-source all evaluation codes, tasks, and data at https://github.com/mrwwk/DeskCraft.

AI.tldr: DeskCraft是一个面向专业创意/工程软件的长周期桌面GUI基准测试，包含多级难度分类（最长达50+步）、形式化的人机协作交互协议（回合中与回合后），评估18个智能体发现GPT-5.4仅达31.6%/27.6%准确率，揭示了长周期工作流执行和主动澄清的持续失败。
AI.motivation: 现有桌面GUI基准测试将任务简化为短周期、指令预先给定的情景，无法反映真实专业工作流中长周期执行与人机协作（智能体主动询问、用户中途干预、反馈修正）的复杂需求。

AI.result: GPT-5.4在标准任务上达31.6%，交互任务上27.6%，揭示长周期工作流交付与主动澄清能力存在持续性失败。
AI.conclusion: 现有智能体在长周期专业工作流和主动人机协作方面仍有显著不足，DeskCraft为未来研究提供了标准化评估框架。

A benchmark framework that evaluates both standard task execution and interactive human-agent collaborative performance on real-world professional workflows.

title: EvoTrainer: Co-Evolving LLM Policies and Training Harnesses for Autonomous Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Autonomous LLM training is often framed as recipe search, which leaves the training harness largely static. This limitation sharpens in agentic RL, where shifting bottlenecks and scalar rewards mask diverse failure modes. We introduce EvoTrainer, an autonomous training framework that co-evolves LLM policies and training-side harnesses through empirical feedback: it diagnoses rollout-level evidence, revises diagnostics, backtests interventions, and accumulates reusable skills. Evaluated on mathematical reasoning, competitive-programming code generation, and repository-level software engineering, EvoTrainer matches or exceeds the human-engineered RL references under the same data, codebase, and evaluation protocol, with the largest gain on long-horizon agentic SWE. Trajectory analyses show that retained strategies diverge across domains, evolving diagnostics prevent invalid high-scoring branches from being promoted, and reusable skills shape later search. Autonomous LLM RL should move beyond recipe search toward joint evolution of policies and the training harnesses that interpret them.

AI.tldr: EvoTrainer是一个自动化LLM训练框架，通过联合进化策略(policies)和训练工具链(training harnesses)来实现自主强化学习，在数学推理、代码生成和软件工程任务上匹配或超越人工设计的RL方法。
AI.motivation: 传统LLM训练被框定为"配方搜索"(recipe search)，训练工具链保持静态，这在agentic RL场景中成为瓶颈：奖励信号稀疏且具有误导性，无法区分多样化的失败模式，导致无效的高分分支被错误提升。
AI.method: EvoTrainer提出联合进化框架：1) 诊断rollout级别的经验证据；2) 修正诊断策略；3) 回测干预措施；4) 积累可复用的技能。通过agentic RL闭环，让训练工具链(policies)和策略(policies)共同进化。
AI.result: 在数学推理、竞赛编程代码生成和仓库级软件工程任务上，EvoTrainer在相同数据、代码库和评估协议下匹配或超越人工设计的RL参考方案，在长周期agentic SWE任务上增益最大。轨迹分析显示保留的策略因领域而异，进化的诊断机制阻止了无效高分分支的晋升，可复用技能影响后续搜索。
AI.conclusion: 自主LLM RL应从配方搜索转向策略与训练工具链的联合进化，让训练框架本身成为可进化的智能体而非静态配置。
idea_en: A co-evolutionary training framework for LLMs where both the policy network and the training harness evolve jointly through empirical feedback, enabling autonomous adaptation of training strategies to shifting task bottlenecks.

A diagnostic-driven RL mechanism that analyzes rollout-level evidence to identify and prevent invalid high-scoring branches from being promoted, addressing the scalar reward masking problem in agentic LLM training.

A skill accumulation system in LLM training that captures reusable behavioral strategies across training iterations, allowing the training harness to leverage past successful interventions for future search optimization.

An automated diagnostic revision system that dynamically updates failure mode classification criteria based on evolving training trajectories, enabling the training harness to adapt its interpretation of agent behaviors.

title: Uncertainty-Aware Clarification in LLM Agents with Information Gain
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents often operate under underspecified user instructions, where latent uncertainty over user intent leads to erroneous tool actions. To address this challenge, we propose a goal-oriented clarification framework that aligns clarification behavior with ambiguity resolution. Central to our approach is the Information Gain Reward, a metric that quantifies the utility of clarification questions by measuring the Bayesian belief update towards the ground-truth goal induced by the clarification exchange. We train the clarifier (LLM) using this reward to optimize for high information gain, ensuring that clarifications effectively reduce uncertainty and improve task completion within the agent-tool-user environment. We validate our framework within a clarification-enhanced $τ$-Bench environment, conducting cross-agent evaluations across five heterogeneous backbones. Empirical results demonstrate that our method consistently improves the success rate by 3.7\% over the no-clarification baseline, while adding only 0.3 total interaction steps on average.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于信息增益奖励的目标导向澄清框架，帮助LLM代理在模糊用户指令下通过提出有信息量的问题来减少意图不确定性，提升工具调用成功率。
AI.motivation: LLM代理常在模糊的用户指令下运行，用户意图存在潜在不确定性，导致错误的工具操作。现有方法缺乏量化澄清问题效用、并以此优化澄清行为的机制。
AI.method: 提出信息增益奖励（Information Gain Reward），通过贝叶斯信念更新度量澄清对话对消除目标不确定性的贡献；训练澄清器（LLM）最大化该奖励，从而生成高信息量的澄清问题。
AI.result: 在τ-Bench环境中跨5种异构基座模型评估，相比无澄清基线，任务成功率平均提升3.7%，而平均交互步骤仅增加0.3步。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的信息增益奖励驱动的澄清框架能有效降低意图不确定性，提升任务完成率，且额外交互开销极小，具有良好的通用性和实用性。
idea_en: A goal-oriented clarification framework for LLM agents that uses Information Gain Reward to quantify the utility of clarification questions via Bayesian belief update towards ground-truth user intent.
A method for training an LLM-based clarifier using Information Gain Reward as optimization objective to generate high-information-gain clarification questions under underspecified user instructions.
Integration of clarification-enhanced agent system with minimal interaction overhead (0.3 additional steps on average) while improving task success rate by 3.7%.
Cross-agent evaluation framework that validates clarification effectiveness across five heterogeneous LLM backbones in a τ-Bench environment.
idea_ch: 一种用于LLM代理的**目标导向澄清框架**，通过**信息增益奖励（Information Gain Reward）**量化澄清问题效用，基于贝叶斯信念更新逼近用户真实意图。
