title: Gender-Dependent Diagnostic Substitution in LLM Medical Triage: Same Symptoms, Unequal Urgency
comment: 7 pages, 3 tables. Multi-model replication across Gemini, Claude, and GPT. Code and data: https://github.com/wongqihan/ai-behavioral-experiments
summary: We investigate whether large language models produce different medical triage recommendations for identical neurological symptoms when only the patient's stated gender and age vary. Using three model families--Gemini 3.5 Flash, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and GPT-5.4-mini--we present a standardized symptom profile (persistent headache, blurred vision, morning nausea, visual disturbances) across seven demographic conditions: three age groups (25, 38, 65) x two genders (male, female), plus a gender-unspecified baseline (n = 30 per condition per model, 630 total trials). We find a stark, systemic gender-dependent triage disparity: young women receive significantly lower emergency room (ER) referral rates than age-matched men (Gemini: 0% vs. 23.3%; Claude: 6.7% vs. 96.7%; GPT: 6.7% vs. 66.7%, all p < 0.001). The disparity disappears at age 65 for all models. The primary mechanism is diagnostic substitution: the models anchor on a gender-associated diagnosis, preferentially classifying young women with Idiopathic Intracranial Hypertension (IIH)--a condition epidemiologically linked to women of childbearing age--while diagnosing men with generic increased intracranial pressure with space-occupying lesions in the differential. This diagnostic closure routes female patients to lower-urgency care (outpatient doctor appointments) despite comparable severity ratings (7-9/10). Our findings demonstrate that clinical LLMs replicate documented human clinical biases by using epidemiological priors to suppress triage urgency, suggesting that AI triage engines must decouple urgency assessment from probabilistic diagnostic priors. We release all code, prompts, and raw results.

AI.tldr: 大语言模型在神经症状分诊中表现出系统性性别偏见：年轻女性被显著低估急症转诊率，原因是模型倾向于使用流行病学先验将女性诊断为特定疾病（特发性颅内高压），从而降低分诊紧迫性。
AI.motivation: 探究大语言模型在医疗分诊中是否因患者性别和年龄差异而产生系统性偏见，揭示AI医疗决策中的潜在公平性问题。
AI.method: 使用三种LLM（Gemini 3.5 Flash、Claude Sonnet 4.6、GPT-5.4-mini），对标准化的神经症状（持续头痛、视力模糊、晨起恶心、视觉障碍）在七种人口统计学条件下（3个年龄组×2个性别+性别未指定基线）进行测试，共630次试验，统计急诊转诊率差异。
AI.result: 年轻女性急诊转诊率显著低于同龄男性（如Gemini: 0% vs 23.3%；Claude: 6.7% vs 96.7%；GPT: 6.7% vs 66.7%，p<0.001）。该差异在65岁年龄组消失。主要机制为诊断替代：模型将女性锚定于特发性颅内高压(IIH，一种与育龄女性相关的疾病），而将男性诊断为非特异性颅内压增高，导致女性被分配至低紧迫性门诊路径。
AI.conclusion: 临床LLM复制了人类医生已知的临床偏见，通过使用流行病学先验抑制了分诊紧迫性。AI分诊引擎必须将紧迫性评估与概率性诊断先验解耦。
idea_en: A method for gender-debiased medical triage using LLMs by decoupling urgency assessment from probabilistic diagnostic priors, where the system independently evaluates symptom severity and triage urgency without being influenced by demographic-specific disease prevalence statistics.

A diagnostic substitution detection system that monitors when an LLM anchors on a demographic-associated diagnosis (e.g., IIH for young women) and flags potential triage urgency suppression, then recalibrates the triage recommendation using severity-independent pathways.

A multi-stage triage framework where the LLM first performs a blinded urgency assessment without demographic information, then subsequently incorporates demographic data for differential diagnosis generation, preventing epidemiological priors from biasing triage decisions.
idea_ch: 一种基于性别去偏的LLM医疗分诊方法：将紧迫性评估与概率性诊断先验解耦，系统独立评估症状严重程度和分诊紧迫性，不受人口统计学相关的疾病患病率统计影响。
一种诊断替代检测系统：监测LLM是否锚定于与人口统计学相关的诊断（如年轻女性的IIH），并标记潜在的分诊紧迫性抑制，随后使用独立于严重程度的路径重新校准分诊建议。
一种多阶段分诊框架：LLM首先在不包含人口统计信息的条件下进行盲法紧迫性评估，随后再引入人口统计数据用于鉴别诊断生成，从而防止流行病学先验对分诊决策产生偏见。

title: Towards Non-Monotonic Entailment in Propositional Defeasible Standpoint Logic
summary: Recent work in defeasible reasoning has seen notions of preferential semantics and entailment in the style of Kraus et al. applied to modal logics. However, work in this field has focussed primarily on satisfiability checking, and monotonic notions of entailment, which may be inferentially weak. One particular modal logic where this has been introduced is propositional standpoint logics, where modalities can express the views of different viewpoints. This has resulted in the formalisation of propositional defeasible standpoint logic (PDSL). In this paper, we propose a means of lifting the class of (non-monotonic) rational entailment relations from traditional KLM-style reasoning to a fragment of PDSL. In order to do so, we extend the expressivity of PDSL via situated standpoint conditionals, allowing us to talk about a defeasible conditional holding in the context of a given standpoint. This allows us to re-characterise the syntax of PDSL in terms of situated conditionals, and shows that a large fragment of PDSL is expressible as a set of situated conditionals. We then focus on characterising non-monotonic entailment in this fragment, defining a method to transport any ranking-based entailment relation from the propositional case into the PDSL case. This is first described in the general case and then considered in the specific cases of rational and lexicographic closures, providing a faithful translation of each inference into PDSL. We also show that entailment-checking in this fragment of PDSL can be done largely using algorithms from the propositional case, while preserving complexity bounds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将KLM风格的非单调理性推理提升到命题可废止立场逻辑(PDSL)中，通过引入情境立场条件句，将PDSL的一个大片段表达为情境条件句集合，并定义了一种将基于排序的推理关系从命题情形迁移到PDSL的方法，包括理性闭包和词典闭包的具体情况，同时保持了计算复杂性。
AI.motivation: 现有的可废止推理在模态逻辑中的研究主要关注可满足性检查和单调推理，推理能力较弱。命题立场逻辑(PSL)虽然能表达不同视角的观点，但缺乏非单调推理机制。本文旨在将KLM风格的非单调理性推理引入命题可废止立场逻辑(PDSL)中，增强其推理能力。
AI.method: 1) 扩展PDSL的表达能力，引入情境立场条件句(situated standpoint conditionals)，使可废止条件句能在特定立场上下文中成立；2) 将PDSL的大片段重新表征为情境条件句集合；3) 定义一种通用方法，将基于排序的推理关系从命题情形迁移到PDSL中；4) 分别考虑理性闭包和词典闭包两种具体情形，提供向PDSL的忠实翻译；5) 利用命题情形的算法实现PDSL片段的推理检查，保持复杂度上界。
AI.result: 成功将非单调理性推理关系提升到PDSL片段中，证明了PDSL大片段可表达为情境条件句集合，实现了理性闭包和词典闭包向PDSL的忠实翻译，推理检查可利用命题情形算法完成且复杂度不变。
AI.conclusion: 本文为非单调推理在模态立场逻辑中的应用提供了理论基础，通过情境立场条件句的引入，实现了从命题可废止推理到PDSL的有效迁移，为多视角下的可废止推理提供了可行的计算框架。
idea_en: A method for lifting KLM-style non-monotonic rational entailment relations to propositional defeasible standpoint logic (PDSL) via situated standpoint conditionals, enabling context-dependent defeasible reasoning across multiple viewpoints.

A technical framework for re-characterizing a large fragment of PDSL syntax as a set of situated conditionals, allowing existing propositional ranking-based algorithms to be applied to modal defeasible reasoning.

A faithful translation method for transporting ranking-based entailment relations (including rational closure and lexicographic closure) from propositional case to PDSL while preserving inference semantics.
A complexity-preserving algorithmic approach for entailment-checking in PDSL that leverages existing propositional defeasible reasoning algorithms, maintaining the same computational bounds.
idea_ch: 一种通过情境立场条件句将KLM风格的非单调理性推理关系提升到命题可废止立场逻辑(PDSL)的方法，实现多视角下的上下文依赖可废止推理。
一种将PDSL的大片段语法重新表征为情境条件句集合的技术框架，使现有的基于命题排序的算法能够应用于模态可废止推理。
一种将基于排序的推理关系（包括理性闭包和词典闭包）从命题情形忠实翻译到PDSL的方法，保持推理语义不变。
一种在PDSL中进行推理检查的复杂度保持算法方法，利用现有的命题可废止推理算法，维持相同的计算复杂度上界。

title: Diagnosing Knowledge Gaps in LLM Tool Use: An Agentic Benchmark for Novel API Acquisition
summary: Large language models for code generation often need to use APIs that are absent from their pretraining data. This requires more than recalling a function name: models must coordinate signatures, module paths, input-output contracts, semantics, and executable usage patterns. Existing novel-API benchmarks are typically static, rely on coarse pass/fail metrics, or use synthetic APIs that may not reflect real library evolution. We introduce NovelAPIBench, a fully automated dynamic benchmark that, for any base model and target library, discovers novel APIs, extracts decomposed knowledge bundles, generates executable coding tasks, and assigns failed samples to six diagnostic categories. Across about 1.9K tasks, four base models, and five domains, we compare knowledge injected through retrieval with knowledge internalized through parametric adaptation. We find that knowledge components are not interchangeable: usage examples are the strongest standalone signal, while the best two-component setting pairs signatures with either mechanisms or examples depending on the domain and backbone. Adding more context, especially source code, can hurt by increasing import-path errors. Parametric adaptation also does not replace retrieval once external knowledge is removed; rather, fine-tuning mainly teaches models how to use provided bundles, and this ability transfers to held-out libraries. These results suggest that retrieval and tuning play complementary roles: retrieval supplies volatile API content, while tuning improves procedural integration.

AI.tldr: NovelAPIBench是首个全自动动态基准测试，用于评估大语言模型在代码生成中处理新API的能力。研究发现：使用示例是最强的单一信号；最佳双组件配置根据领域将签名与机制或示例配对；额外上下文（尤其源代码）可能增加导入路径错误；参数调优不能替代检索，两者互补——检索提供易变的API内容，调优改进程序整合能力。
AI.motivation: 现有新型API基准测试通常是静态的、依赖粗粒度的通过/失败指标，或使用不能反映真实库演化的合成API。需要一种动态、细粒度的基准来评估LLM处理真实新API的能力。
AI.method: 提出NovelAPIBench全自动动态基准测试框架：为任意基础模型和目标库发现新API，提取分解的知识包（签名、机制、示例、源代码等），生成可执行的编码任务，并将失败样本分配到6个诊断类别。在约1900个任务、4个基座模型、5个领域上进行实验。
AI.result: 1) 知识组件不可互换：使用示例是最强的单一信号；2) 最佳双组件配置根据领域将签名与机制或示例配对；3) 添加更多上下文（尤其源代码）可能因增加导入路径错误而有害；4) 参数调优不能替代检索，微调主要教会模型如何使用提供的知识包，且该能力可迁移到未见的库。
AI.conclusion: 检索和微调具有互补角色：检索提供易变的API内容，微调改进程序整合能力。建议在实际部署中结合两者。
idea_en: A fully automated dynamic benchmark system (NovelAPIBench) that discovers novel APIs from any target library, extracts decomposed knowledge bundles (signatures, mechanisms, usage examples, source code), generates executable coding tasks, and categorizes failures into six diagnostic types for large language model code generation.
A method for evaluating non-interchangeability of knowledge components in API usage, where usage examples are identified as the strongest standalone signal for code generation with novel APIs.
A two-component knowledge configuration approach for novel API coding tasks that pairs signatures with either mechanisms or examples depending on the domain and backbone model.
A diagnostic categorization system with six failure types for API-related code generation errors, enabling fine-grained analysis of model weaknesses.
A complementary retrieval-tuning framework where retrieval supplies volatile API content while parametric adaptation (fine-tuning) improves procedural integration of API knowledge.
idea_ch: 一种全自动动态基准测试系统(NovelAPIBench)，能够从任意目标库中发现新API、提取分解的知识包（签名、机制、使用示例、源代码）、生成可执行的编码任务，并将大语言模型的失败样本归类到六种诊断类型。
一种评估知识组件在API使用中不可互换性的方法，发现使用示例是代码生成中处理新API的最强单一信号。
一种针对新API编码任务的双组件知识配置方法，根据领域和基座模型的不同，将签名与机制或示例进行配对。
一种包含六种失败类型的诊断分类系统，用于API相关代码生成错误，可实现对模型弱点的细粒度分析。
一种检索-调优互补框架，其中检索提供易变的API内容，而参数调优改进API知识的程序整合能力。

title: From Answers to States: Verifiable Process-Level Evaluation of Chemical Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as chemistry assistants, yet most chemistry benchmarks still score only final answers. This masks a critical failure mode: a model may output the correct molecule, product, or option while its reasoning violates chemical logic. Existing process-level evaluators are hard to scale because LLM judges and human step-level process annotation are costly, inconsistent, and vulnerable to hallucination. We introduce ChemCoTBench-V2, a rule-verifiable diagnostic benchmark for low-cost, auditable evaluation of structured, verifier-addressable chemical reasoning traces. It spans molecular understanding, molecule editing, molecular optimization, and reaction prediction, with 5,620 evaluation samples across 18 reporting tasks. Models must expose key intermediate steps in expert-designed templates, and those steps are checked with deterministic chemistry rules and, for closed-answer tasks, reference traces rather than another LLM judge. Open-ended molecular optimization is evaluated with oracle-verifiable state constraints rather than strict trace matching. The benchmark reports three separate signals: final-answer correctness, template adherence, and step-wise verifier correctness over expert-refined intermediate commitments. Experiments on frontier models reveal a persistent gap between final-answer success and structured-reasoning-state consistency: models often follow the requested format while failing chemical-step checks, or answer correctly with weak supporting reasoning. ChemCoTBench-V2 enables fine-grained model comparison and identifies the concrete step at which the trace first violates the verifier.

AI.tldr: ChemCoTBench-V2 是一个基于规则可验证的结构化化学推理诊断基准，通过确定性规则和参考轨迹而非 LLM 裁判来评估模型的中间推理步骤，填补了化学 AI 中最终答案正确但推理过程不合逻辑的评估空白。
AI.motivation: 现有化学基准仅评估最终答案，忽视了模型推理过程违反化学逻辑的关键失败模式；基于 LLM 的过程评估器成本高、不一致且易产生幻觉，缺乏可扩展的低成本、可审计的推理过程评估方法。
AI.method: 构建包含 5,620 个评估样本、覆盖分子理解/编辑/优化/反应预测 4 大领域 18 个报告任务的基准；设计专家模板要求模型暴露关键中间步骤；用确定性化学规则和参考轨迹（而非 LLM 裁判）验证步骤；对开放分子优化任务使用 oracle 可验证状态约束而非严格轨迹匹配；报告最终答案正确性、模板遵循度和步骤级验证器正确性三项指标。

title: EvoDrive: Pareto Evolution for Safety-Critical Autonomous Driving via Self-Improving LLM Agents
summary: Generating safety-critical scenarios is essential for validating and improving autonomous driving systems, yet it inherently requires maximizing adversariality to expose failures while preserving realism. Existing methods usually manage this trade-off with handcrafted heuristics, confining generation to known priors and overlooking underexplored patterns. While recent open-ended agentic evolution can push this limit, unconstrained general agents lack strict simulator grounding and tend to collapse the multi-objective tension into single-scalar maximization. Here we present EvoDrive, the first automated, LLM-based agentic evolution framework for multi-objective scenario generation. EvoDrive employs a simulator-grounded actor-critic architecture where a memory-driven actor iteratively proposes improvements to the generators and critics filter out implausible candidates, and a self-evolving world evaluator routes promising proposals to optimize simulation budgets. EvoDrive further maintains a Pareto archive of evaluated candidates to preserve diverse attack-realism trade-offs and guide future evolution via simulation feedback. Benchmark results on MetaDrive and CARLA show that EvoDrive not only significantly expands the Pareto frontier across various generators, but also produces valuable scenarios for policy training.

AI.tldr: EvoDrive是一个基于LLM的智能体进化框架，用于自动驾驶安全关键场景的多目标生成，通过模拟器接地演员-评论家架构和Pareto存档，有效平衡攻击性与真实感。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖手工启发式规则处理安全关键场景生成中攻击性与真实感的权衡，限制了探索未知模式的能力；无约束通用智能体则缺乏模拟器接地，容易将多目标张力坍缩为单一标量最大化。
AI.method: 采用模拟器接地的演员-评论家架构：记忆驱动的演员迭代提出改进方案，评论家过滤不可行候选；自进化世界评估器路由有前景的方案以优化仿真预算；维护Pareto存档保存多样化攻击-真实感权衡，通过仿真反馈指导未来进化。
AI.result: 在MetaDrive和CARLA基准测试中，EvoDrive显著扩展了各种生成器的Pareto前沿，并产生了对策略训练有价值的场景。
AI.conclusion: EvoDrive首次实现了基于LLM的自动化智能体进化框架用于多目标场景生成，有效平衡了攻击性与真实感，并扩展了探索边界。

title: The DeepSpeak-Agentic Dataset
summary: We present DeepSpeak-Agentic, a dataset of videos comprising over 37 hours of semi-structured conversations between a human and an embodied AI agent. We use this dataset to evaluate the automatic forensic identification (audio, video, or text) of AI agents, study the nature of human-agent interactions, and provide a benchmark for future advances in the large-language models and AI-generated voices and faces that power embodied AI agents. We also contribute a scalable data-capture system that creates agents, automatically pairs them with human crowd workers, records audiovisual conversations across specified scenarios, and identifies and separates the human and agent in the combined stream.

AI.tldr: DeepSpeak-Agentic是一个包含37小时人机对话视频的数据集，用于AI代理的取证识别、人机交互研究及基准测试，同时提供了一个可扩展的数据采集系统。
AI.motivation: 随着具身AI代理（由大语言模型、AI生成声音和面部驱动）的普及，需要自动化的取证方法来识别AI代理（音频、视频或文本），以及研究人机交互的本质。
AI.method: 构建了一个可扩展的数据采集系统：创建AI代理，自动与人类众包工人配对，在指定场景下录制视听对话，并在混合流中识别和分离人类与AI代理。最终形成包含37+小时半结构化对话的视频数据集。
AI.result: 产出了DeepSpeak-Agentic数据集（37+小时人机对话视频），用于评估AI代理的自动取证识别、分析人机交互特征，并为未来研究提供基准。

title: SkillPyramid: A Hierarchical Skill Consolidation Framework for Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Recent AI agents can flexibly invoke skills to solve complex tasks, but their long-term improvement is fundamentally constrained by a lack of systematic skill construction, accumulation, and transfer. In particular, without a unified framework for skill consolidation, agents tend to redundantly construct similar capabilities across different tasks, are unable to effectively transform experience into reusable assets, and struggle to generalize task-specific skills to novel scenarios. To address this limitation, we propose SkillPyramid, a skill consolidation framework that reuses existing skill experience for broader task generalization. Operating on a hierarchical skill topology, SkillPyramid further introduces a self-evolution mechanism that enables agents to compose, validate, and incorporate new skills during task execution. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld across four backbone models show that SkillPyramid substantially increases the average reward by 38.0% and reduces execution steps by 27.7%. Overall, our method transforms a skill collection from a static resource pool into a dynamic evolution system.

AI.tldr: SkillPyramid是一个技能整合框架，通过分层技能拓扑和自进化机制，将静态技能池转化为动态进化系统，显著提升AI智能体在复杂任务中的泛化能力和执行效率。
AI.motivation: 现有AI智能体虽能灵活调用技能解决复杂任务，但缺乏系统性的技能构建、积累和迁移框架，导致不同任务间冗余构建相似能力，无法有效将经验转化为可复用资产，且难以将技能泛化到新场景。
AI.method: 提出SkillPyramid框架：(1) 构建分层技能拓扑结构；(2) 引入自进化机制，使智能体在任务执行过程中能够组合、验证并纳入新技能。

AI.conclusion: SkillPyramid将技能集合从静态资源池转变为动态进化系统，有效解决了技能复用和泛化问题。

title: Dynamic Objective Selection with Safeguards and LLM Oversight for Financial Decision-Making
comment: Accpeted to The 2nd Workskop on Advances in Financial AI Workshop: Towards Agentic and Responsible Systems at ICLR 2026
summary: Financial decision-making tasks such as stock recommendation and portfolio allocation typically estimate future return and risk and then select trades or allocations for an investor, and the chosen optimization objective often determines realized performance. However, because market conditions evolve over time, a fixed objective can be suboptimal across regimes, while regime-switching pipelines that rely on latent regime estimates can be noisy or delayed and frequent switching can increase turnover and operational instability. In this paper, we propose DOSS (Dynamic Objective Selection with Safeguards), a learning-based selector that directly chooses the decision-relevant objective function at each time point from interpretable statistical summaries of recent returns, selecting among a small set of candidates (e.g., return-seeking, loss-averse, and risk-adjusted) without introducing intermediate regime variables. DOSS formulates objective selection as a classification problem over objectives and performs sequential updates with a rolling window to make forward-looking selections without temporal leakage, while also outputting a confidence score for each proposal. To mitigate misselection and excessive switching in deployment, DOSS applies confidence-aware gating with a fail-safe that overrides low-confidence proposals to a conservative default and enforces explicit controls tied to switching frequency. We further integrate governance by positioning a Large Language Model (LLM) as an oversight component rather than a generator of new objectives: the LLM is restricted to accept a proposed objective or override it to a predefined safe default, with deterministic rule-based constraints triggering overrides when needed.

AI.tldr: 提出DOSS框架，将目标函数选择建模为分类问题，通过滚动窗口学习直接选择适合当前市场环境的优化目标，并引入置信度门控和LLM监督机制防止误选和过度切换。
AI.motivation: 金融市场中固定优化目标无法适应不同市场状态，而隐状态切换方法存在噪声大、延迟高、切换频繁导致运营不稳定等问题，需要一种更稳健的动态目标选择机制。
AI.method: DOSS将目标选择转化为分类问题，基于近期收益的统计摘要直接选择决策相关的目标函数（如追求收益、规避损失、风险调整等），使用滚动窗口进行顺序更新以避免时间泄漏；输出置信度分数，应用置信度感知门控和fail-safe机制（低置信度时回退到保守默认值），并显式控制切换频率；引入LLM作为监督组件（仅接受或否决为安全默认值，不生成新目标）。
AI.result: 论文未提供具体实验结果，仅描述了方法框架和设计原理。
AI.conclusion: DOSS通过直接学习目标选择、置信度门控和LLM监督，提供了一种动态适应市场变化同时避免过度切换和误选的稳健金融决策框架。
idea_en: A dynamic objective selection method for financial decision-making that formulates objective function selection as a classification problem over a small set of candidate objectives (e.g., return-seeking, loss-averse, risk-adjusted) based on interpretable statistical summaries of recent returns, using rolling-window sequential updates without temporal leakage.

A confidence-aware gating mechanism with fail-safe override that automatically reverts to a conservative default objective when the confidence score of the selected objective is below a threshold, combined with explicit controls on switching frequency to prevent excessive turnover and operational instability.

A hybrid governance framework where a Large Language Model (LLM) is positioned as an oversight component rather than objective generator: the LLM is restricted to either accept a proposed objective or override it to a predefined safe default, with deterministic rule-based constraints triggering overrides when needed.

A forward-looking objective selection pipeline that directly chooses the decision-relevant optimization objective at each time point from interpretable statistical summaries, without introducing intermediate latent regime variables, thereby avoiding noise and delay issues of regime-switching approaches.
idea_ch: 一种用于金融决策的动态目标选择方法，将目标函数选择建模为基于近期收益统计摘要的分类问题，在少量候选目标（如追求收益、规避损失、风险调整）中进行选择，采用滚动窗口顺序更新且无时间泄漏。

一种混合治理框架，将大语言模型（LLM）定位为监督组件而非目标生成器：LLM被限制为接受提议的目标或将其覆盖为预定义的默认安全目标，并辅以基于规则的确定性约束在需要时触发覆盖。

title: Code-on-Graph: Iterative Programmatic Reasoning via Large Language Models on Knowledge Graphs
summary: Knowledge Graphs (KGs) are widely used to mitigate the limitations of Large Language Models (LLMs), such as outdated knowledge and hallucinations. Existing LLM-KG integration frameworks typically rely on predefined operators to retrieve factual knowledge from KGs and inject it into prompts for answer generation. This paradigm faces two critical bottlenecks: 1) Inflexibility: The predefined operators are limited in scope and thus lack sufficient compositional expressiveness to fully capture the complex semantics required by KG questions. 2) Unscalability: Direct injection of factual knowledge into prompts limits scalability in handling large-scale factual knowledge. To address these two bottlenecks, we propose Code-on-Graph (CoG), a programmatic reasoning framework for LLM-KG integration. Specifically, given the factual knowledge retrieved at each reasoning step, CoG first identifies the corresponding KG schemas and represents these schemas as Python classes, which serve as abstract interfaces to the retrieved facts. It then generates executable code grounded in these classes, with the retrieved facts instantiated as objects of the corresponding classes during execution. This design enables flexible code-based reasoning while avoiding the direct injection of large-scale factual knowledge into prompts. Experiments on WebQSP, CWQ, and GrailQA demonstrate that CoG outperforms prior state-of-the-art models by up to 10.5%.

AI.tldr: 提出Code-on-Graph (CoG)框架，通过将KG模式表示为Python类并生成可执行代码，实现灵活的代码式推理，避免将大规模事实知识直接注入提示中。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM-KG集成框架依赖预定义操作符检索KG事实并注入提示，存在两个瓶颈：1) 预定义操作符缺乏组合表达能力，无法完全捕捉KG问题的复杂语义；2) 直接将事实知识注入提示在处理大规模事实知识时可扩展性差。
AI.method: CoG框架：在每个推理步骤中，首先检索事实知识，然后识别对应的KG模式并将其表示为Python类（作为检索事实的抽象接口），再生成基于这些类的可执行代码，执行时将检索到的事实实例化为相应类的对象。
AI.result: 在WebQSP、CWQ和GrailQA数据集上，CoG相比之前最先进模型性能提升高达10.5%。
AI.conclusion: CoG通过程序化推理框架，将KG模式映射为代码类并生成可执行代码，解决了现有方法灵活性不足和可扩展性差的问题，显著提升了LLM-KG集成的性能。

A method for generating executable code grounded in KG schema classes, where retrieved facts are dynamically instantiated as objects during code execution, avoiding prompt bloat.
A stepwise KG reasoning approach that identifies corresponding schemas from retrieved factual knowledge and converts them into programmatic abstractions for LLM processing.

title: Unveiling the Structure of Do-Calculus Reasoning via Derivation Graphs
summary: The do-calculus defines a general system of inference for interventional queries, allowing causal quantities to be transformed through successive applications of its rules. This process induces a rich space of equivalent interventional expressions, but combining and ordering these rules remains challenging. In this work, we introduce derivation graphs, which represent how do-calculus rules are applied and combined, and characterize the full space of observational and interventional probabilities which are equivalent under the do-calculus. The structure of these graphs yields a simple procedure that uses at most four applications of do-calculus rules. Finally, we show how applying identification algorithms to equivalent causal queries produces multiple valid estimands for the same causal quantity, eventually yielding more efficient estimators.

AI.tldr: 本文提出推导图（derivation graphs）来表示do-calculus规则的组合应用，刻画了所有在do-calculus下等价的观察和干预概率空间，并展示了如何通过最多四次规则应用生成等价的因果查询，进而得到更高效的估计量。
AI.motivation: do-calculus定义了干预查询的通用推理系统，但其规则的组合与排序具有挑战性，导致难以系统性地探索等价的因果表达空间。
AI.method: 引入推导图（derivation graphs）表示do-calculus规则的应用与组合过程，基于图结构给出一个最多使用四次规则应用的简单流程。
AI.result: 推导图能完整刻画do-calculus下等价的观察和干预概率空间，且最多四次规则应用即可实现等价变换。将识别算法应用于等价因果查询可产生多个有效估计量，最终得到更高效的估计器。
AI.conclusion: 推导图为do-calculus规则的系统化组合提供了结构化框架，通过等价因果查询的多样性可以提升因果效应估计的效率。

A procedure using at most four applications of do-calculus rules to characterize equivalent interventional expressions.
Method for generating multiple valid estimands by applying identification algorithms to equivalent causal queries.

Graph-based framework for automating the transformation of causal quantities via do-calculus rules.

title: When to Re-Plan: Subgoal Persistence in Hierarchical Latent Reasoning
comment: Accepted at the Workshop on Compositional Learning: Safety, Interpretability, and Agents (CompLearn), ICML 2026. 10 pages, 2 figures
summary: Long-horizon reasoning requires a system to commit to medium-horizon intent without becoming rigid: re-plan too often and computation never coheres into multi-step structure; commit too long and the plan goes stale. We study this stability-adaptivity tradeoff in the latent reasoning setting, where multi-step computation occurs inside hidden state rather than externalized token traces. We extend the Hierarchical Reasoning Model (HRM) with a feudal-style manager-worker interface: a slow high-level module periodically emits a normalized directional subgoal that persists for P low-level steps, biasing the worker's hidden-state updates and supplying an intrinsic cosine alignment loss. On ARC and ConceptARC, we find that subgoal persistence -- not subgoal injection alone -- is the central knob: moderate periods P in [3, 6] consistently outperform both very frequent (P=1) and very long horizons, with a clear minimum LM loss at P=3 (1.544 vs. 1.674 at P=1, 1.640 baseline; replicated over 5 seeds at mean 1.595, std 0.045). The intrinsic alignment weight lambda shows a complementary narrow optimum (lambda approximately 0.05). A controlled ablation at past-sweet-spot lambda isolates learned directional structure -- not architectural capacity or auxiliary loss alone -- as the source of interference when the alignment signal exceeds its optimum. Together these findings implicate a design principle for compositional planning in latent reasoning systems: medium-horizon intent must be coherent across enough computational steps for compositional structure to form.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了潜在推理系统中的稳定性-适应性权衡，通过层次化推理模型(HRM)中的封建式管理-工人接口，发现子目标持久性（而非子目标注入本身）是性能的关键调节旋钮，中等持久期P∈[3,6]表现最佳，对齐权重λ存在窄范围最优值(≈0.05)。
AI.motivation: 长视野推理需要在中期意图的承诺与灵活性之间取得平衡：重新规划太频繁会导致计算无法形成多步结构，承诺太久则计划会过时。研究旨在理解这一稳定性-适应性权衡在潜在推理设置中的表现。
AI.method: 扩展层次化推理模型(HRM)，引入封建式管理-工人接口：慢速高级模块周期性发出归一化方向性子目标，该子目标持续P个低层级步骤，偏置工人的隐藏状态更新并提供内在余弦对齐损失。
AI.result: 在ARC和ConceptARC上，中等持久期P∈[3,6]一致优于高频(P=1)和过长视野；LM损失在P=3时最低(1.544 vs P=1的1.674，基线1.640)，5个种子实验均值1.595，标准差0.045。内在对齐权重λ存在窄范围最优值(λ≈0.05)。消融实验表明学习到的方向性结构是对齐信号超过最优值时干扰的主要来源。
AI.conclusion: 组合规划在潜在推理系统中的设计原则：中期意图必须在足够多的计算步骤上保持连贯，以形成组合结构。
idea_en: Feudal-style manager-worker architecture with periodic subgoal injection for latent reasoning systems, where a slow high-level module emits normalized directional subgoals that persist for multiple low-level steps to bias hidden-state updates
Adaptive subgoal persistence mechanism with tunable period P and intrinsic cosine alignment loss for controlling stability-adaptivity tradeoff in hierarchical reasoning
Directional subgoal representation learning through cosine alignment loss between manager's subgoal and worker's hidden state updates in latent space
Controlled interference detection method via ablation at past-sweet-spot alignment weight to isolate learned directional structure as source of performance degradation
idea_ch: 封建式管理-工人架构的潜在推理系统：慢速高层模块周期性发出归一化方向性子目标，持久作用于多个低层级步骤以偏置隐藏状态更新
可调节子目标持久性机制：通过可调周期P和内在余弦对齐损失控制层次化推理中的稳定性-适应性权衡
方向性子目标表征学习方法：利用管理者子目标与工人隐藏状态更新之间的余弦对齐损失进行潜在空间中的方向性学习
通过消融实验检测干扰源的方法：在历史最优对齐权重处进行消融，隔离学习到的方向性结构作为性能退化的主要来源

title: Proof-Refactor: Refactoring Generated Formal Proofs into Modular Artifacts
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong performance in generating formal proofs, their outputs often remain less readable, modular, maintainable, and reusable than proofs in mature formal mathematics libraries. We argue that this gap stems in part from the compile-first objective implicit in most proof-generation pipelines, which encourages monolithic or ad hoc proof scripts rather than library-quality artifacts. Existing approaches to proof-quality improvement often rely on explicit, computable optimization objectives. In practice, however, the most tractable and experimentally validated objectives are largely length-based, while higher-level qualities such as readability, modularity, maintainability, and reusability are difficult to reduce to reliable automatic metrics. Instead of optimizing proof improvement against a single proxy metric, we take a process-guided approach inspired by human proof-refactoring workflows. We propose an agentic framework $\textbf{Proof-Refactor}$ that decomposes proof refactoring into four phases: extracting candidate proof fragments, designing helper declarations, formally proving the extracted and designed components, and repairing the original proof using the verified components. On generated Lean proofs from PutnamBench and Putnam2025, Proof-Refactor improves rubric-based refactoring scores over a strong Claude Code refactoring baseline, with the largest gains in signature quality and human readability. These results suggest that process-guided refactoring can improve proof structure without treating proof length as the primary objective.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Proof-Refactor框架，通过模拟人类重构工作流的四阶段方法（提取候选证明片段、设计辅助声明、形式化证明、修复原始证明）来改进LLM生成的正式证明质量，而不依赖长度等单一代理指标。实验表明，该方法在可读性、模块化和签名质量等维度优于强基线。
AI.motivation: LLM生成的正式证明在可读性、模块化、可维护性和可重用性方面远逊于成熟数学库中的证明。现有方法多依赖可计算的优化目标（主要是长度指标），而更高级的质量属性难以自动度量。
AI.method: 提出Proof-Refactor框架，将证明重构分解为四个阶段：(1) 提取候选证明片段；(2) 设计辅助声明（helper declarations）；(3) 形式化证明提取和设计的组件；(4) 使用已验证的组件修复原始证明。该方法模拟人类证明重构工作流，不依赖单一代理度量。
AI.result: 在PutnamBench和Putnam2025的Lean证明数据集上，Proof-Refactor在基于评分标准的重构得分上优于Claude Code强基线，在签名质量和人类可读性方面提升最大。
AI.conclusion: 过程引导的重构方法可以在不将证明长度作为主要优化目标的情况下改善证明结构，为生成更接近库质量的正式证明提供了新路径。
idea_en: 1. A four-phase agentic framework for formal proof refactoring that decomposes proof improvement into extraction, design, verification, and repair stages, mimicking human refactoring workflows.
2. A method for automated extraction of candidate proof fragments from monolithic LLM-generated proofs, enabling modular decomposition.
3. A system for designing helper declarations (lemmas, theorems, definitions) that capture reusable proof patterns from extracted fragments.
4. A technique for formally proving extracted and designed helper components using an automated prover or LLM, then integrating them back into the original proof via repair.
5. A process-guided proof improvement approach that does not rely on proof length as the primary optimization objective, addressing higher-level qualities like readability and modularity.
idea_ch: 1. 一种四阶段智能体框架用于正式证明重构，将证明改进分解为提取、设计、验证和修复阶段，模拟人类重构工作流。
2. 一种从LLM生成的单一化证明中自动提取候选证明片段的方法，支持模块化解构。
3. 一种自动设计辅助声明（引理、定理、定义）的系统，从提取的片段中捕获可重用的证明模式。
4. 一种技术：使用自动证明器或LLM对提取和设计的辅助组件进行形式化证明，然后通过修复将其集成回原始证明。
5. 一种过程引导的证明改进方法，不将证明长度作为主要优化目标，而是关注可读性和模块化等更高级的质量属性。

title: LAP: An Agent-to-Instrument Protocol for Autonomous Science
summary: Autonomous science is moving from demonstration to infrastructure. Large language model agents now plan experiments, and self-driving laboratories execute them. Yet every such system rebuilds the link between the reasoning agent and the physical instrument from scratch, against fragmented vendor SDKs and standards built for deterministic software clients rather than probabilistic, goal-directed agents. Recent agent-interoperability protocols clarify two of the three edges of an agentic ecosystem (Anthropic's Model Context Protocol (MCP) standardizes the agent-to-tool edge, and Google's Agent2Agent (A2A) the agent-to-agent edge), but neither models the agent-to-instrument edge, where operations are stateful, safety-critical, exclusively owned, physically embodied, and produce measurements with units, calibration, and uncertainty. We present the Lab Agent Protocol (LAP), a protocol design that fills this gap. LAP retains A2A's peer-to-peer, discovery-first, task-lifecycle structure and adds four physical-world primitives: (i) the InstrumentCard, a signed capability and physical-limit description; (ii) first-class reservation for exclusive instrument and sample locking; (iii) a safety-fence handshake with operator-confirmation tokens cryptographically bound to a specific task and its parameters, gating hazardous and irreversible operations; and (iv) a MeasurementResult schema that makes every result physically typed (QUDT/UCUM), calibration-anchored, uncertainty-bearing, and reproducible by construction. We specify roles, a six-layer architecture, the JSON-RPC method set, the task and safety state machines, the error model, and cross-laboratory federation, and walk a closed-loop autonomous campaign through the protocol end-to-end. LAP is transport-compatible with the A2A/MCP ecosystem and encapsulates rather than replaces existing device standards such as SiLA 2 and OPC-UA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Lab Agent Protocol (LAP)，一个填补大语言模型智能体与物理实验仪器之间通信空白的协议，在现有A2A/MCP生态基础上增加了仪器能力描述、独占预约、安全围栏和带物理类型的测量结果等四大物理世界原语。
AI.motivation: 现有自主科学系统每次都需要从零构建推理智能体与物理仪器之间的连接，而现有的智能体互操作协议（MCP、A2A）仅覆盖了智能体-工具和智能体-智能体边缘，未处理智能体-仪器边缘的物理世界特性（有状态、安全关键、独占性、物理实体、带单位的测量结果）。
AI.method: LAP保留了A2A的点对点、发现优先、任务生命周期结构，新增四个物理世界原语：1) InstrumentCard（签名能力与物理限制描述）；2) 独占仪器与样本锁定的一级预约；3) 安全围栏握手机制，使用操作员确认令牌（密码学绑定到特定任务和参数）来门控危险及不可逆操作；4) MeasurementResult模式，使每个结果具有物理类型（QUDT/UCUM）、校准锚定、带不确定度且可复现。协议还定义了六层架构、JSON-RPC方法集、任务/安全状态机、错误模型和跨实验室联邦。
AI.result: LAP与A2A/MCP生态传输兼容，封装而非替代现有设备标准（如SiLA 2和OPC-UA），并通过完整的端到端闭环自主实验流程验证。
AI.conclusion: LAP填补了智能体-仪器边缘的标准化空白，为自主科学从演示走向基础设施提供了关键的协议支撑。
idea_en: Lab Agent Protocol (LAP) with InstrumentCard: A signed capability and physical-limit description structure that enables autonomous agents to discover and understand instrument specifications, constraints, and safe operating ranges before task execution.
First-class reservation system with exclusive instrument and sample locking mechanism for agent-driven laboratories, preventing conflicts in multi-agent autonomous experimentation environments.

Safety-fence handshake protocol using operator-confirmation tokens cryptographically bound to specific task parameters, gating hazardous and irreversible physical operations in autonomous science systems.
MeasurementResult schema with physical typing via QUDT/UCUM, calibration anchoring, uncertainty quantification, and reproducibility guarantees for autonomous laboratory measurements.
Six-layer architecture for agent-instrument communication that bridges high-level AI reasoning with physical laboratory equipment, compatible with existing A2A and MCP ecosystems.
Cross-laboratory federation mechanism enabling autonomous agents to discover and operate instruments across different physical laboratory sites through a unified protocol.
idea_ch: Lab Agent Protocol (LAP)仪器卡片：一种带有签名的能力与物理限制描述结构，使自主智能体能在任务执行前发现并理解仪器的技术规格、约束和安全操作范围。
一级预约系统与独占仪器及样本锁定机制，防止多智能体自主实验环境中的资源冲突，确保仪器操作的独占性。
安全围栏握手协议：使用密码学绑定到特定任务参数的操作员确认令牌，在自主科学系统中门控危险及不可逆的物理操作。
测量结果模式：基于QUDT/UCUM的物理类型化、校准锚定、不确定度量化且具备可复现保证的自主实验室测量结果数据格式。
六层架构的智能体-仪器通信协议：桥接高层AI推理与物理实验设备，兼容现有A2A和MCP生态系统。
跨实验室联邦机制：使自主智能体能够通过统一协议发现和操作跨不同物理实验室站点的仪器设备。
